ko.title: 공식 가입 기간 수주 앞으로 다가와: 보험료, 보조금 및 플랜 선택 시 비교할 사항

segments.src: Open enrollment is the yearly window when many people can sign up for health coverage or change the plan they already have.
segments.tr: 공식 가입 기간(Open enrollment)은 많은 사람들이 건강 보험에 가입하거나 기존 플랜을 변경할 수 있는 연례 기간입니다.

segments.src: For millions of households, the choices made over a few weeks will shape monthly budgets and out-of-pocket costs for the whole next year.
segments.tr: 수백만 가구에게 몇 주 동안 내리는 선택은 다음 해 전체의 월간 예산과 본인 부담 비용을 결정짓게 됩니다.

segments.src: Details vary by employer, state and insurer, so treat the points below as a general guide and confirm specifics with official sources.
segments.tr: 고용주, 주 및 보험사에 따라 세부 사항이 달라지므로 아래 내용은 일반적인 가이드로 참고하시고 세부 사항은 공식 출처를 통해 확인하시기 바랍니다.

segments.src: ## Two Enrollment Seasons, Two Sets of Rules
segments.tr: ## 두 가지 가입 기간, 두 가지 규칙

segments.src: Most people fall into one of two groups.
segments.tr: 대부분의 사람들은 다음 두 그룹 중 하나에 해당합니다.

segments.src: - **Marketplace shoppers** buy individual coverage through HealthCare.gov or a state-run exchange. In most states, the federal window has typically opened on November 1. Some state exchanges run on different schedules, and the end date can differ, so check your own exchange's calendar.
segments.tr: - **마켓플레이스 이용자**는 HealthCare.gov 또는 주에서 운영하는 거래소를 통해 개인 보험 구매를 진행합니다. 대부분의 주에서 연방 가입 기간은 보통 11월 1일에 시작됩니다. 일부 주 거래소는 다른 일정으로 운영되며 종료일이 다를 수 있으므로 해당 주 거래소의 일정을 확인하세요.

segments.src: - **Employer plan members** choose from the options their workplace offers. These windows are usually set by the employer, often in the fall, and can be short. Missing one may mean waiting until next year unless you have a qualifying life event.
segments.tr: - **직장 보험 가입자**는 직장에서 제공하는 옵션 중에서 선택합니다. 이 가입 기간은 보통 가을철에 고용주가 설정하며 기간이 짧을 수 있습니다. 이 기간을 놓치면 자격 요건이 되는 특별한 삶의 변화(qualifying life event)가 없는 한 다음 해까지 기다려야 할 수 있습니다.

segments.src: Qualifying life events, such as losing other coverage, marriage, or the birth of a child, can open a separate special enrollment period.
segments.tr: 기존 보험 상실, 결혼, 자녀 출산과 같은 자격 요건 사건이 발생하면 별도의 특별 가입 기간이 열릴 수 있습니다.

segments.src: ## Premiums: Look Past the Sticker Price
segments.tr: ## 보험료: 표면적인 가격 그 이상을 고려하세요

segments.src: Insurers file proposed rates each year, and regulators review them.
segments.tr: 보험사는 매년 제안 요율을 제출하고 규제 기관이 이를 검토합니다.

segments.src: Whether your own premium goes up, down or stays flat depends on your insurer, county and plan.
segments.tr: 귀하의 보험료가 인상, 인하 또는 동결될지 여부는 보험사, 거주 지역(County) 및 플랜에 따라 다릅니다.

segments.src: Drivers commonly cited by insurers include medical costs, prescription drug spending and how many people are enrolled.
segments.tr: 보험사가 흔히 언급하는 요율 변동 요인으로는 의료비, 처방약 지출, 가입자 수가 있습니다.

segments.src: When you compare, keep these points in mind:
segments.tr: 비교할 때 다음 사항을 염두에 두세요.

segments.src: 1. **The monthly premium is only one part of the cost.** A lower premium often comes with a higher deductible.
segments.tr: 1. **월 보험료는 전체 비용의 일부분일 뿐입니다.** 보험료가 낮을수록 공제금(deductible)이 높은 경우가 많습니다.

segments.src: 2. **Check the total picture.** Add up twelve months of premiums, then consider the deductible, copayments, coinsurance and the out-of-pocket maximum.
segments.tr: 2. **전체적인 그림을 확인하세요.** 12개월 치 보험료를 합산한 후 공제금, 정액 분담금(copayments), 정률 분담금(coinsurance) 및 본인 부담 최대 한도액(out-of-pocket maximum)을 고려하세요.

segments.src: 3. **Compare against your actual use.** If you expect regular specialist visits or ongoing prescriptions, a plan with a higher premium but lower cost-sharing may cost less overall.
segments.tr: 3. **실제 의료 이용량과 비교하세요.** 정기적인 전문의 진료나 지속적인 약 처방이 예상되는 경우, 보험료가 높더라도 비용 분담 비율이 낮은 플랜이 전체적인 비용을 절감할 수 있습니다.

segments.src: ## Subsidies: Re-Check Your Eligibility
segments.tr: ## 보조금: 자격 요건 재확인하기

segments.src: Marketplace premium tax credits reduce monthly premiums for eligible households.
segments.tr: 마켓플레이스 보험료 세액 공제(premium tax credit)는 자격 요건을 갖춘 가구의 월 보험료를 줄여줍니다.

segments.src: The amount depends on household income, household size, the cost of benchmark plans in your area and the subsidy rules in effect for the year.
segments.tr: 보조금 금액은 가구 소득, 가구원 수, 해당 지역의 기준 플랜(benchmark plan) 비용 및 해당 연도에 적용되는 보조금 규정에 따라 결정됩니다.

segments.src: Because those rules have been subject to change by Congress, do not assume last year's help will look the same this year.
segments.tr: 이러한 규정은 의회에 의해 변경될 수 있으므로 지난해 받던 혜택이 올해도 동일할 것이라고 단정하지 마세요.

segments.src: Practical steps:
segments.tr: 실질적인 조치 단계:

segments.src: - **Update your application** with current income and household details instead of letting an old application renew automatically.
segments.tr: - 이전 신청서가 자동 갱신되도록 두지 말고 현재의 소득 및 가구 세부 정보로 **신청서를 업데이트하세요**.

segments.src: - **Estimate income carefully.** Credits are generally reconciled when you file taxes, so a large gap between estimated and actual income can lead to owing money or receiving a larger refund.
segments.tr: - **소득을 신중하게 추정하세요.** 세액 공제는 일반적으로 세금 신고 시 정산되므로 추정 소득과 실제 소득 간의 차이가 크면 세금을 추가 납부해야 하거나 더 큰 환급을 받게 될 수 있습니다.

segments.src: - **Use the exchange's window-shopping or estimator tool** to see your likely cost before you commit.
segments.tr: - 가입을 확정하기 전에 **거래소의 구경하기(window-shopping) 또는 추정 도구를 사용**하여 예상 비용을 확인하세요.

segments.src: - **Ask about other help**, such as cost-sharing reductions on certain silver-tier plans for lower-income enrollees, or Medicaid and CHIP, which are available year-round to those who qualify.
segments.tr: - 저소득 가입자를 위한 특정 실버 등급 플랜의 비용 분담 감면(cost-sharing reductions)이나, 자격을 갖춘 경우 연중 언제든 가입 가능한 메디케이드(Medicaid) 및 CHIP과 같은 **기타 지원 혜택에 대해 문의하세요**.

segments.src: ## Shrinking Plan Choices: What to Do If Your Plan Changes
segments.tr: ## 줄어드는 플랜 선택지: 플랜이 변경되는 경우 대처법

segments.src: In some areas, insurers leave markets, narrow their offerings or adjust their networks.
segments.tr: 일부 지역에서는 보험사가 시장에서 철수하거나 제공 상품을 축소하거나 네트워크를 조정합니다.

segments.src: Employers may also change carriers or benefit designs.
segments.tr: 고용주 역시 보험사를 변경하거나 혜택 설계를 수정할 수 있습니다.

segments.src: If your current plan is discontinued or altered, you may be moved to a different plan automatically, and it may not match what you had.
segments.tr: 현재 가입한 플랜이 중단되거나 변경되면 다른 플랜으로 자동 이동될 수 있으며, 이는 기존 혜택과 일치하지 않을 수 있습니다.

segments.src: - **Read your renewal notice** as soon as it arrives. It should describe changes to cost and coverage.
segments.tr: - 갱신 통지서가 도착하는 즉시 **읽어보세요**. 비용 및 보장 내용의 변경 사항이 기술되어 있어야 합니다.

segments.src: - **Verify your doctors and hospitals** are in the network of any plan you consider. Use the insurer's directory and, when possible, call the provider's office to confirm.
segments.tr: - 고려 중인 플랜의 네트워크에 **의사와 병원이 포함되어 있는지 확인하세요**. 보험사의 주소록을 이용하고, 가능하면 의료기관에 직접 전화하여 확인하세요.

segments.src: - **Check the drug formulary** for each medication you take, including the tier it falls in and any prior authorization requirement.
segments.tr: - 등급(tier)과 사전 승인 요구 사항을 포함하여 복용 중인 각 약물에 대한 **처방약 목록(formulary)을 확인하세요**.

segments.src: - **Understand the network type.** HMO plans usually require referrals and in-network care. PPO plans offer more flexibility, often at a higher price.
segments.tr: - **네트워크 유형을 이해하세요.** HMO 플랜은 보통 진료 의뢰서와 네트워크 내 진료를 요구합니다. PPO 플랜은 더 높은 비용으로 더 많은 자율성을 제공합니다.

segments.src: ## A Simple Comparison Checklist
segments.tr: ## 간단한 비교 체크리스트

segments.src: Before you choose, line up your top two or three options and compare:
segments.tr: 선택하기 전에 가장 마음에 드는 2~3가지 옵션을 정렬하여 비교해 보세요.

segments.src: | Question | Why it matters |
segments.tr: | 질문 | 중요한 이유 |

segments.src: | Monthly premium after any subsidy | Your fixed monthly cost |
segments.tr: | 보조금 적용 후 월 보험료 | 고정 월 비용 |

segments.src: | Deductible | What you pay before most coverage begins |
segments.tr: | 공제금 (Deductible) | 대부분의 보장이 시작되기 전에 본인이 부담하는 금액 |

segments.src: | Out-of-pocket maximum | Your worst-case yearly spending on covered care |
segments.tr: | 본인 부담 최대 한도액 (Out-of-pocket maximum) | 보장되는 진료에 대한 연간 최악의 지출 금액 |

segments.src: | Copays and coinsurance | Your cost per visit or service |
segments.tr: | 정액 및 정률 분담금 (Copays and coinsurance) | 방문 또는 서비스당 본인 부담 비용 |

segments.src: | Network and referrals | Whether your providers are covered |
segments.tr: | 네트워크 및 진료 의뢰서 | 이용하는 의료진의 보장 여부 |

segments.src: | Drug coverage | Cost of regular prescriptions |
segments.tr: | 약품 보장 | 정기 처방약 비용 |

segments.src: | HSA eligibility (if applicable) | Possible tax-advantaged savings with certain high-deductible plans |
segments.tr: | HSA 자격 여부(해당 시) | 특정 높은 공제금 플랜을 통한 절세형 저축 가능성 |

segments.src: ## Employer Plans: Extra Items to Review
segments.tr: ## 직장 보험: 추가로 검토할 사항

segments.src: - **Employer contribution:** Compare how much your employer pays toward each option, since this can change the real cost gap between plans.
segments.tr: - **고용주 분담금:** 고용주가 각 옵션에 부담하는 금액을 비교하세요. 이는 플랜 간의 실제 비용 격차를 바꿀 수 있습니다.

segments.src: - **Spouse and dependent coverage:** Family costs can rise sharply. Check whether a spouse's employer offers a better option.
segments.tr: - **배우자 및 부양가족 보장:** 가족 비용이 급격히 증가할 수 있습니다. 배우자의 직장에서 더 나은 옵션을 제공하는지 확인하세요.

segments.src: - **FSA and HSA rules:** Flexible spending accounts often have use-it-or-lose-it limits. Review deadlines and carryover rules.
segments.tr: - **FSA 및 HSA 규정:** 유연 지출 계정(FSA)은 소멸성 한도가 있는 경우가 많습니다. 마감일과 이월 규정을 검토하세요.

segments.src: - **Opt-out or surcharge rules:** Some employers charge extra if a covered spouse has other coverage available.
segments.tr: - **옵션 제외 또는 추가금 규정:** 일부 고용주는 보장 가능한 배우자가 다른 보험에 가입할 수 있는 경우 추가 요금을 부과합니다.

segments.src: ## Avoiding Common Mistakes
segments.tr: ## 흔한 실수 피하기

segments.src: - **Waiting until the last day.** Websites can be slow near deadlines, and a missed date can leave you without coverage.
segments.tr: - **마지막 날까지 미루기.** 마감일 근처에는 웹사이트가 느려질 수 있으며, 날짜를 놓치면 보장 없이 지낼 수 있습니다.

segments.src: - **Auto-renewing without looking.** Premiums, networks and subsidy amounts may have changed.
segments.tr: - **확인 없이 자동 갱신하기.** 보험료, 네트워크, 보조금 금액이 변경되었을 수 있습니다.

segments.src: - **Choosing on premium alone.** The cheapest plan can be the most expensive if you need significant care.
segments.tr: - **보험료만 보고 선택하기.** 상당한 진료가 필요한 경우 가장 저렴한 플랜이 가장 비싼 플랜이 될 수 있습니다.

segments.src: - **Using unofficial sites.** Enroll only through your exchange, your employer's benefits portal or a licensed agent or broker. Be cautious of unsolicited calls or messages asking for personal information.
segments.tr: - **비공식 사이트 이용하기.** 거래소, 고용주의 혜택 포털, 또는 라이선스가 있는 대리인/중개인을 통해서만 가입하세요. 개인 정보를 요구하는 스팸 전화나 메시지에 주의하세요.

segments.src: ## Where to Get Help
segments.tr: ## 도움을 받을 수 있는 곳

segments.src: Free, trained assistance is available.
segments.tr: 무료 전문 도움을 받으실 수 있습니다.

segments.src: Exchanges offer navigators and certified assistance counselors, and state insurance departments can answer questions about plans and complaints.
segments.tr: 거래소는 내비게이터 및 인증된 보조 상담사를 제공하며, 주 보험국은 플랜에 대한 질문과 불만 사항에 답해줄 수 있습니다.

segments.src: Your employer's benefits office or human resources team can explain workplace options.
segments.tr: 고용주의 복리후생 부서나 인사팀에서 직장 옵션에 대해 설명해 줄 수 있습니다.

segments.src: ## The Bottom Line
segments.tr: ## 요약

segments.src: Open enrollment rewards a little preparation.
segments.tr: 공식 가입 기간에는 약간의 준비가 결실을 맺습니다.

segments.src: Gather your income details, list your doctors and prescriptions, note the deadlines that apply to you, and compare total expected costs rather than premiums alone.
segments.tr: 소득 세부 정보를 수집하고, 이용하는 의사와 처방약 목록을 정리하고, 적용되는 마감일을 확인하고, 보험료뿐만 아니라 전체 예상 비용을 비교하세요.

segments.src: A review of an hour or two now can help you avoid surprises later.
segments.tr: 지금 1~2시간 동안 검토하면 나중에 예기치 못한 지출을 방지하는 데 도움이 될 수 있습니다.

segments.src: *This article is for general information only and is not medical, legal, tax or financial advice.
segments.tr: *본 문서는 일반적인 정보 제공만을 목적으로 하며 의학적, 법적, 세무적 또는 금융 자문이 아닙니다.

segments.src: Plan details, prices and eligibility rules change, so confirm current information with your exchange, insurer or employer before enrolling.*
segments.tr: 플랜 세부 사항, 가격 및 자격 규정은 변경될 수 있으므로 가입하기 전에 거래소, 보험사 또는 고용주를 통해 최신 정보를 확인하시기 바랍니다.*

zh.title: 开放注册期即将来临：如何对比保费、补贴和计划选择

segments.src: Open enrollment is the yearly window when many people can sign up for health coverage or change the plan they already have.
segments.tr: 开放注册期是许多人可以注册健康保险或更改现有计划的年度窗口期。

segments.src: For millions of households, the choices made over a few weeks will shape monthly budgets and out-of-pocket costs for the whole next year.
segments.tr: 对于数百万家庭来说，在短短几周内做出的选择将决定下一年全年的每月预算和自付费用。

segments.src: Details vary by employer, state and insurer, so treat the points below as a general guide and confirm specifics with official sources.
segments.tr: 具体细节因雇主、州和保险公司而异，因此请将以下内容作为一般指南，并向官方渠道确认具体细节。

segments.src: ## Two Enrollment Seasons, Two Sets of Rules
segments.tr: ## 两个注册季，两套规则

segments.src: Most people fall into one of two groups.
segments.tr: 大多数人属于以下两类群体之一。

segments.src: - **Marketplace shoppers** buy individual coverage through HealthCare.gov or a state-run exchange. In most states, the federal window has typically opened on November 1. Some state exchanges run on different schedules, and the end date can differ, so check your own exchange's calendar.
segments.tr: - **市场购险者**通过 HealthCare.gov 或州营交易平台购买个人保险。在大多数州，联邦窗口期通常于 11 月 1 日开启。一些州营交易平台的时间表有所不同，截止日期也可能不同，因此请查看您所在交易平台的日程表。

segments.src: - **Employer plan members** choose from the options their workplace offers. These windows are usually set by the employer, often in the fall, and can be short. Missing one may mean waiting until next year unless you have a qualifying life event.
segments.tr: - **雇主计划成员**从其工作单位提供的选项中进行选择。这些窗口期通常由雇主设定，多在秋季，且时间可能很短。错过窗口期可能意味着必须等到下一年，除非您遇到了符合条件的生命事件。

segments.src: Qualifying life events, such as losing other coverage, marriage, or the birth of a child, can open a separate special enrollment period.
segments.tr: 符合条件的生命事件（如失去其他保险、结婚或生子）可以开启一个单独的特殊注册期。

segments.src: ## Premiums: Look Past the Sticker Price
segments.tr: ## 保费：不要只看标价

segments.src: Insurers file proposed rates each year, and regulators review them.
segments.tr: 保险公司每年都会提交拟定费率，并由监管机构进行审查。

segments.src: Whether your own premium goes up, down or stays flat depends on your insurer, county and plan.
segments.tr: 您个人的保费是上涨、下降还是保持不变，取决于您的保险公司、所在县和所选计划。

segments.src: Drivers commonly cited by insurers include medical costs, prescription drug spending and how many people are enrolled.
segments.tr: 保险公司通常提及的驱动因素包括医疗成本、处方药支出以及参保人数。

segments.src: When you compare, keep these points in mind:
segments.tr: 在进行对比时，请记住以下几点：

segments.src: 1. **The monthly premium is only one part of the cost.** A lower premium often comes with a higher deductible.
segments.tr: 1. **月保费只是成本的一部分。** 较低的保费通常伴随着较高的免赔额。

segments.src: 2. **Check the total picture.** Add up twelve months of premiums, then consider the deductible, copayments, coinsurance and the out-of-pocket maximum.
segments.tr: 2. **查看整体情况。** 将 12 个月的保费相加，然后考虑免赔额、定额手续费（copayments）、共同保险（coinsurance）和自付费用最高限额。

segments.src: 3. **Compare against your actual use.** If you expect regular specialist visits or ongoing prescriptions, a plan with a higher premium but lower cost-sharing may cost less overall.
segments.tr: 3. **根据您的实际使用情况进行对比。** 如果您预计需要定期看专科医生或长期服用处方药，那么保费较高但分摊费用较低的计划在总体上可能花费更少。

segments.src: ## Subsidies: Re-Check Your Eligibility
segments.tr: ## 补贴：重新核实您的资格

segments.src: Marketplace premium tax credits reduce monthly premiums for eligible households.
segments.tr: 市场保费税收抵免可为符合条件的家庭降低月保费。

segments.src: The amount depends on household income, household size, the cost of benchmark plans in your area and the subsidy rules in effect for the year.
segments.tr: 具体金额取决于家庭收入、家庭人口数、您所在地区基准计划的成本以及当年生效的补贴规则。

segments.src: Because those rules have been subject to change by Congress, do not assume last year's help will look the same this year.
segments.tr: 由于这些规则可能会受到国会的修改，因此不要假设去年的帮助在今年会完全相同。

segments.src: Practical steps:
segments.tr: 实用步骤：

segments.src: - **Update your application** with current income and household details instead of letting an old application renew automatically.
segments.tr: - **更新您的申请**，填写当前的收入和家庭详细信息，而不是让旧申请自动续期。

segments.src: - **Estimate income carefully.** Credits are generally reconciled when you file taxes, so a large gap between estimated and actual income can lead to owing money or receiving a larger refund.
segments.tr: - **仔细估算收入。** 抵免额通常在您报税时进行结算，因此估算收入与实际收入之间的巨大差距可能会导致您欠税或获得更多退税。

segments.src: - **Use the exchange's window-shopping or estimator tool** to see your likely cost before you commit.
segments.tr: - **使用交易平台的预选或估算工具**，在做出决定前查看您可能需要支付的费用。

segments.src: - **Ask about other help**, such as cost-sharing reductions on certain silver-tier plans for lower-income enrollees, or Medicaid and CHIP, which are available year-round to those who qualify.
segments.tr: - **询问其他帮助**，例如针对低收入参保人员的某些银级计划的费用分摊削减，或者全年向符合条件者开放的 Medicaid 和 CHIP。

segments.src: ## Shrinking Plan Choices: What to Do If Your Plan Changes
segments.tr: ## 计划选择减少：如果您的计划发生变化该怎么办

segments.src: In some areas, insurers leave markets, narrow their offerings or adjust their networks.
segments.tr: 在某些地区，保险公司会退出市场、缩减提供的产品或调整其网络。

segments.src: Employers may also change carriers or benefit designs.
segments.tr: 雇主也可能会更换承保公司或调整福利设计。

segments.src: If your current plan is discontinued or altered, you may be moved to a different plan automatically, and it may not match what you had.
segments.tr: 如果您当前的计划被终止或更改，您可能会被自动转入另一个不同的计划，而它可能与您之前的计划并不匹配。

segments.src: - **Read your renewal notice** as soon as it arrives. It should describe changes to cost and coverage.
segments.tr: - **一收到续期通知就立即阅读。** 它应该说明了费用和承保范围的变化。

segments.src: - **Verify your doctors and hospitals** are in the network of any plan you consider. Use the insurer's directory and, when possible, call the provider's office to confirm.
segments.tr: - **核实您的医生和医院**是否在您考虑的任何计划的网络内。使用保险公司的名录，并在可能的情况下致电提供者的办公室进行确认。

segments.src: - **Check the drug formulary** for each medication you take, including the tier it falls in and any prior authorization requirement.
segments.tr: - **检查药品目录**，确认您服用的每种药物，包括其所属的层级以及任何预先授权要求。

segments.src: - **Understand the network type.** HMO plans usually require referrals and in-network care. PPO plans offer more flexibility, often at a higher price.
segments.tr: - **了解网络类型。** HMO 计划通常需要转诊和网络内治疗。PPO 计划提供更多灵活性，但价格通常更高。

segments.src: ## A Simple Comparison Checklist
segments.tr: ## 简易对比清单

segments.src: Before you choose, line up your top two or three options and compare:
segments.tr: 在做出选择之前，将您最中意的两到三个选项列出来并进行对比：

segments.src: | Question | Why it matters |
segments.tr: | 问题 | 为什么重要 |

segments.src: | Monthly premium after any subsidy | Your fixed monthly cost |
segments.tr: | 补贴后的月保费 | 您的固定月度成本 |

segments.src: | Deductible | What you pay before most coverage begins |
segments.tr: | 免赔额 | 在大多数承保开始前您需要支付的金额 |

segments.src: | Out-of-pocket maximum | Your worst-case yearly spending on covered care |
segments.tr: | 自付费用最高限额 | 在最坏情况下，您每年在承保医疗服务上的最高支出 |

segments.src: | Copays and coinsurance | Your cost per visit or service |
segments.tr: | 定额手续费和共同保险 | 您每次就诊或接受服务的成本 |

segments.src: | Network and referrals | Whether your providers are covered |
segments.tr: | 网络和转诊 | 您的医疗提供者是否在承保范围内 |

segments.src: | Drug coverage | Cost of regular prescriptions |
segments.tr: | 药品承保 | 定期处方药的成本 |

segments.src: | HSA eligibility (if applicable) | Possible tax-advantaged savings with certain high-deductible plans |
segments.tr: | HSA 资格（如适用） | 某些高免赔额计划可能带来的免税储蓄 |

segments.src: ## Employer Plans: Extra Items to Review
segments.tr: ## 雇主计划：需要审查的额外项目

segments.src: - **Employer contribution:** Compare how much your employer pays toward each option, since this can change the real cost gap between plans.
segments.tr: - **雇主缴费比例：** 对比您的雇主为每个选项支付了多少费用，因为这会改变计划之间的实际成本差距。

segments.src: - **Spouse and dependent coverage:** Family costs can rise sharply. Check whether a spouse's employer offers a better option.
segments.tr: - **配偶和受抚养人承保：** 家庭成本可能会急剧上升。检查配偶的雇主是否提供了更好的选择。

segments.src: - **FSA and HSA rules:** Flexible spending accounts often have use-it-or-lose-it limits. Review deadlines and carryover rules.
segments.tr: - **FSA 和 HSA 规则：** 弹性支出账户（FSA）通常有“不使用即作废”的限制。审查截止日期和结转规则。

segments.src: - **Opt-out or surcharge rules:** Some employers charge extra if a covered spouse has other coverage available.
segments.tr: - **不参保或附加费规则：** 如果被承保的配偶有其他可用的保险，一些雇主会收取额外费用。

segments.src: ## Avoiding Common Mistakes
segments.tr: ## 避免常见错误

segments.src: - **Waiting until the last day.** Websites can be slow near deadlines, and a missed date can leave you without coverage.
segments.tr: - **拖延到最后一天。** 临近截止日期时网站可能会变慢，错过日期可能会让您失去保障。

segments.src: - **Auto-renewing without looking.** Premiums, networks and subsidy amounts may have changed.
segments.tr: - **不加查看地自动续期。** 保费、网络和补贴金额可能已经发生了变化。

segments.src: - **Choosing on premium alone.** The cheapest plan can be the most expensive if you need significant care.
segments.tr: - **仅根据保费做出选择。** 如果您需要大量的医疗服务，最便宜的计划可能会变成最昂贵的计划。

segments.src: - **Using unofficial sites.** Enroll only through your exchange, your employer's benefits portal or a licensed agent or broker. Be cautious of unsolicited calls or messages asking for personal information.
segments.tr: - **使用非官方网站。** 仅通过您的交易平台、雇主的福利门户网站或持牌代理人或经纪人进行注册。警惕索要个人信息的未经请求的电话或信息。

segments.src: ## Where to Get Help
segments.tr: ## 从哪里获取帮助

segments.src: Free, trained assistance is available.
segments.tr: 您可以获得免费且经过培训的协助。

segments.src: Exchanges offer navigators and certified assistance counselors, and state insurance departments can answer questions about plans and complaints.
segments.tr: 交易平台提供导航员和认证协助顾问，州保险部门可以回答有关计划和投诉的问题。

segments.src: Your employer's benefits office or human resources team can explain workplace options.
segments.tr: 您雇主的福利办公室或人力资源团队可以解释工作单位的选项。

segments.src: ## The Bottom Line
segments.tr: ## 总结

segments.src: Open enrollment rewards a little preparation.
segments.tr: 开放注册期会让做好准备的人受益。

segments.src: Gather your income details, list your doctors and prescriptions, note the deadlines that apply to you, and compare total expected costs rather than premiums alone.
segments.tr: 收集您的收入详情，列出您的医生和处方药，记下适用于您的截止日期，并对比预期的总成本，而不仅仅是保费。

segments.src: A review of an hour or two now can help you avoid surprises later.
segments.tr: 现在花一两个小时进行审查，可以帮助您避免日后的意外状况。

segments.src: *This article is for general information only and is not medical, legal, tax or financial advice.
segments.tr: *本文仅供一般参考，不构成医疗、法律、税务或财务建议。

segments.src: Plan details, prices and eligibility rules change, so confirm current information with your exchange, insurer or employer before enrolling.*
segments.tr: 计划详情、价格和资格规则会发生变化，因此在注册前，请与您的交易平台、保险公司或雇主确认最新信息。*

hi.title: ओपन एनरोलमेंट में बस कुछ सप्ताह बाकी हैं: प्रीमियम, सब्सिडी और प्लान के विकल्पों में क्या तुलना करें

segments.src: Open enrollment is the yearly window when many people can sign up for health coverage or change the plan they already have.
segments.tr: ओपन एनरोलमेंट (Open enrollment) वह वार्षिक अवधि है जब कई लोग स्वास्थ्य कवरेज के लिए साइन अप कर सकते हैं या अपने पास मौजूद मौजूदा प्लान को बदल सकते हैं।

segments.src: For millions of households, the choices made over a few weeks will shape monthly budgets and out-of-pocket costs for the whole next year.
segments.tr: लाखों परिवारों के लिए, कुछ हफ़्तों में लिए गए निर्णय पूरे अगले वर्ष के लिए मासिक बजट और आउट-ऑफ-पॉकेट खर्चों को तय करेंगे।

segments.src: Details vary by employer, state and insurer, so treat the points below as a general guide and confirm specifics with official sources.
segments.tr: विवरण नियोक्ता, राज्य और बीमाकर्ता के अनुसार भिन्न होते हैं, इसलिए नीचे दिए गए बिंदुओं को एक सामान्य गाइड के रूप में लें और आधिकारिक स्रोतों से बारीकियों की पुष्टि करें।

segments.src: ## Two Enrollment Seasons, Two Sets of Rules
segments.tr: ## दो एनरोलमेंट सीजन, नियमों के दो सेट

segments.src: Most people fall into one of two groups.
segments.tr: अधिकांश लोग दो में से एक समूह में आते हैं।

segments.src: - **Marketplace shoppers** buy individual coverage through HealthCare.gov or a state-run exchange. In most states, the federal window has typically opened on November 1. Some state exchanges run on different schedules, and the end date can differ, so check your own exchange's calendar.
segments.tr: - **मार्केटप्लेस खरीदार** HealthCare.gov या राज्य द्वारा संचालित एक्सचेंज के माध्यम से व्यक्तिगत कवरेज खरीदते हैं। अधिकांश राज्यों में, संघीय अवधि आमतौर पर 1 नवंबर को शुरू होती है। कुछ राज्य एक्सचेंज अलग-अलग समय सारणी पर चलते हैं, और अंतिम तिथि भिन्न हो सकती है, इसलिए अपने स्वयं के एक्सचेंज का कैलेंडर जांचें।

segments.src: - **Employer plan members** choose from the options their workplace offers. These windows are usually set by the employer, often in the fall, and can be short. Missing one may mean waiting until next year unless you have a qualifying life event.
segments.tr: - **नियोक्ता प्लान के सदस्य** उन विकल्पों में से चुनते हैं जो उनका कार्यस्थल प्रदान करता है। ये समय सीमाएं आमतौर पर नियोक्ता द्वारा निर्धारित की जाती हैं, अक्सर शरद ऋतु में, और छोटी हो सकती हैं। एक बार चूक जाने का मतलब अगले साल तक इंतजार करना हो सकता है जब तक कि आपके पास कोई अर्हक जीवन घटना (qualifying life event) न हो।

segments.src: Qualifying life events, such as losing other coverage, marriage, or the birth of a child, can open a separate special enrollment period.
segments.tr: अर्हक जीवन घटनाएं, जैसे कि अन्य कवरेज खोना, विवाह, या बच्चे का जन्म, एक अलग विशेष एनरोलमेंट अवधि (special enrollment period) खोल सकती हैं।

segments.src: ## Premiums: Look Past the Sticker Price
segments.tr: ## प्रीमियम: केवल स्टिकर मूल्य न देखें

segments.src: Insurers file proposed rates each year, and regulators review them.
segments.tr: बीमाकर्ता हर साल प्रस्तावित दरें दाखिल करते हैं, और नियामक उनकी समीक्षा करते हैं।

segments.src: Whether your own premium goes up, down or stays flat depends on your insurer, county and plan.
segments.tr: आपका खुद का प्रीमियम बढ़ता है, घटता है या स्थिर रहता है, यह आपके बीमाकर्ता, काउंटी और प्लान पर निर्भर करता है।

segments.src: Drivers commonly cited by insurers include medical costs, prescription drug spending and how many people are enrolled.
segments.tr: बीमाकर्ताओं द्वारा आमतौर पर बताए जाने वाले कारणों में चिकित्सा लागत, प्रिस्क्रिप्शन दवा खर्च और कितने लोग नामांकित हैं शामिल हैं।

segments.src: When you compare, keep these points in mind:
segments.tr: जब आप तुलना करते हैं, तो इन बातों को ध्यान में रखें:

segments.src: 1. **The monthly premium is only one part of the cost.** A lower premium often comes with a higher deductible.
segments.tr: 1. **मासिक प्रीमियम लागत का केवल एक हिस्सा है।** कम प्रीमियम अक्सर उच्च डिडक्टिबल (deductible) के साथ आता है।

segments.src: 2. **Check the total picture.** Add up twelve months of premiums, then consider the deductible, copayments, coinsurance and the out-of-pocket maximum.
segments.tr: 2. **पूरी तस्वीर जांचें।** बारह महीनों के प्रीमियम को जोड़ें, फिर डिडक्टिबल, को-पेमेंट, को-इंश्योरेंस और आउट-ऑफ-पॉकेट अधिकतम (out-of-pocket maximum) पर विचार करें।

segments.src: 3. **Compare against your actual use.** If you expect regular specialist visits or ongoing prescriptions, a plan with a higher premium but lower cost-sharing may cost less overall.
segments.tr: 3. **अपने वास्तविक उपयोग से तुलना करें।** यदि आप नियमित रूप से विशेषज्ञ के पास जाने या निरंतर दवाओं की उम्मीद करते हैं, तो अधिक प्रीमियम लेकिन कम लागत-साझाकरण (cost-sharing) वाला प्लान कुल मिलाकर कम खर्चीला हो सकता है।

segments.src: ## Subsidies: Re-Check Your Eligibility
segments.tr: ## सब्सिडी: अपनी पात्रता की पुन: जांच करें

segments.src: Marketplace premium tax credits reduce monthly premiums for eligible households.
segments.tr: मार्केटप्लेस प्रीमियम टैक्स क्रेडिट पात्र परिवारों के लिए मासिक प्रीमियम को कम करते हैं।

segments.src: The amount depends on household income, household size, the cost of benchmark plans in your area and the subsidy rules in effect for the year.
segments.tr: यह राशि घरेलू आय, परिवार के आकार, आपके क्षेत्र में बेंचमार्क प्लान की लागत और उस वर्ष के लिए लागू सब्सिडी नियमों पर निर्भर करती है।

segments.src: Because those rules have been subject to change by Congress, do not assume last year's help will look the same this year.
segments.tr: चूंकि वे नियम कांग्रेस द्वारा परिवर्तन के अधीन रहे हैं, इसलिए यह न मानें कि पिछले वर्ष की मदद इस वर्ष भी वैसी ही दिखेगी।

segments.src: Practical steps:
segments.tr: व्यावहारिक कदम:

segments.src: - **Update your application** with current income and household details instead of letting an old application renew automatically.
segments.tr: - पुराने आवेदन को स्वचालित रूप से नवीनीकृत होने देने के बजाय वर्तमान आय और पारिवारिक विवरण के साथ **अपने आवेदन को अपडेट करें**।

segments.src: - **Estimate income carefully.** Credits are generally reconciled when you file taxes, so a large gap between estimated and actual income can lead to owing money or receiving a larger refund.
segments.tr: - **आय का ध्यानपूर्वक अनुमान लगाएं।** टैक्स दाखिल करते समय क्रेडिट का मिलान किया जाता है, इसलिए अनुमानित और वास्तविक आय के बीच बड़ा अंतर होने से पैसे चुकाने पड़ सकते हैं या बड़ा रिफंड मिल सकता है।

segments.src: - **Use the exchange's window-shopping or estimator tool** to see your likely cost before you commit.
segments.tr: - प्रतिबद्ध होने से पहले अपनी संभावित लागत देखने के लिए **एक्सचेंज के विंडो-शॉपिंग या अनुमानक टूल का उपयोग करें**।

segments.src: - **Ask about other help**, such as cost-sharing reductions on certain silver-tier plans for lower-income enrollees, or Medicaid and CHIP, which are available year-round to those who qualify.
segments.tr: - **अन्य सहायता के बारे में पूछें**, जैसे कि कम आय वाले नामांकित व्यक्तियों के लिए कुछ सिल्वर-स्तरीय प्लान पर लागत-साझाकरण में कटौती (cost-sharing reductions), या मेडिकेयर और CHIP, जो पात्र लोगों के लिए साल भर उपलब्ध हैं।

segments.src: ## Shrinking Plan Choices: What to Do If Your Plan Changes
segments.tr: ## प्लान के घटते विकल्प: यदि आपका प्लान बदलता है तो क्या करें

segments.src: In some areas, insurers leave markets, narrow their offerings or adjust their networks.
segments.tr: कुछ क्षेत्रों में, बीमाकर्ता बाजार छोड़ देते हैं, अपनी पेशकशों को सीमित कर देते हैं या अपने नेटवर्क को समायोजित करते हैं।

segments.src: Employers may also change carriers or benefit designs.
segments.tr: नियोक्ता भी वाहक (carriers) या लाभ डिजाइनों को बदल सकते हैं।

segments.src: If your current plan is discontinued or altered, you may be moved to a different plan automatically, and it may not match what you had.
segments.tr: यदि आपका वर्तमान प्लान बंद या परिवर्तित हो जाता है, तो आपको स्वचालित रूप से एक अलग प्लान में स्थानांतरित किया जा सकता है, और यह आपके पास पहले से मौजूद प्लान से मेल नहीं खा सकता है।

segments.src: - **Read your renewal notice** as soon as it arrives. It should describe changes to cost and coverage.
segments.tr: - जैसे ही आपका **नवीनीकरण नोटिस** आए, उसे पढ़ें। इसमें लागत और कवरेज में बदलाव का वर्णन होना चाहिए।

segments.src: - **Verify your doctors and hospitals** are in the network of any plan you consider. Use the insurer's directory and, when possible, call the provider's office to confirm.
segments.tr: - **सत्यापित करें कि आपके डॉक्टर और अस्पताल** आपके द्वारा विचार किए जाने वाले किसी भी प्लान के नेटवर्क में हैं। बीमाकर्ता की निर्देशिका का उपयोग करें और, जब संभव हो, पुष्टि करने के लिए प्रदाता के कार्यालय में कॉल करें।

segments.src: - **Check the drug formulary** for each medication you take, including the tier it falls in and any prior authorization requirement.
segments.tr: - आपके द्वारा ली जाने वाली प्रत्येक दवा के लिए **दवा फॉर्मूलरी (drug formulary) की जांच करें**, जिसमें उसका स्तर (tier) और कोई पूर्व प्राधिकरण (prior authorization) आवश्यकता शामिल है।

segments.src: - **Understand the network type.** HMO plans usually require referrals and in-network care. PPO plans offer more flexibility, often at a higher price.
segments.tr: - **नेटवर्क के प्रकार को समझें।** HMO प्लान में आमतौर पर रेफ़रल और इन-नेटवर्क देखभाल की आवश्यकता होती है। PPO प्लान अक्सर अधिक कीमत पर, अधिक लचीलापन प्रदान करते हैं।

segments.src: ## A Simple Comparison Checklist
segments.tr: ## एक सरल तुलना चेकलिस्ट

segments.src: Before you choose, line up your top two or three options and compare:
segments.tr: चुनने से पहले, अपने शीर्ष दो या तीन विकल्पों को पंक्तिबद्ध करें और तुलना करें:

segments.src: ## Employer Plans: Extra Items to Review
segments.tr: ## नियोक्ता प्लान: समीक्षा करने के लिए अतिरिक्त बातें

segments.src: - **Employer contribution:** Compare how much your employer pays toward each option, since this can change the real cost gap between plans.
segments.tr: - **नियोक्ता योगदान:** तुलना करें कि आपका नियोक्ता प्रत्येक विकल्प में कितना भुगतान करता है, क्योंकि यह प्लान के बीच वास्तविक लागत के अंतर को बदल सकता है।

segments.src: - **Spouse and dependent coverage:** Family costs can rise sharply. Check whether a spouse's employer offers a better option.
segments.tr: - **पति/पत्नी और आश्रित कवरेज:** पारिवारिक लागत तेजी से बढ़ सकती है। जांचें कि क्या पति/पत्नी का नियोक्ता बेहतर विकल्प प्रदान करता है।

segments.src: - **FSA and HSA rules:** Flexible spending accounts often have use-it-or-lose-it limits. Review deadlines and carryover rules.
segments.tr: - **FSA और HSA नियम:** फ्लेक्सिबल स्पेंडिंग अकाउंट (FSA) में अक्सर 'उपयोग करें या खो दें' (use-it-or-lose-it) की सीमाएं होती हैं। समय सीमा और कैरीओवर नियमों की समीक्षा करें।

segments.src: - **Opt-out or surcharge rules:** Some employers charge extra if a covered spouse has other coverage available.
segments.tr: - **ऑप्ट-आउट या सरचार्ज नियम:** यदि किसी कवर किए गए पति/पत्नी के पास अन्य कवरेज उपलब्ध है, तो कुछ नियोक्ता अतिरिक्त शुल्क लेते हैं।

segments.src: ## Avoiding Common Mistakes
segments.tr: ## आम गलतियों से बचना

segments.src: - **Waiting until the last day.** Websites can be slow near deadlines, and a missed date can leave you without coverage.
segments.tr: - **अंतिम दिन तक प्रतीक्षा करना।** समय सीमा के करीब वेबसाइटें धीमी हो सकती हैं, और समय सीमा चूक जाने से आप बिना कवरेज के रह सकते हैं।

segments.src: - **Auto-renewing without looking.** Premiums, networks and subsidy amounts may have changed.
segments.tr: - **बिना देखे ऑटो-रिन्यू करना।** प्रीमियम, नेटवर्क और सब्सिडी राशि बदल सकती है।

segments.src: - **Choosing on premium alone.** The cheapest plan can be the most expensive if you need significant care.
segments.tr: - **केवल प्रीमियम के आधार पर चुनाव करना।** यदि आपको महत्वपूर्ण देखभाल की आवश्यकता है तो सबसे सस्ता प्लान सबसे महंगा हो सकता है।

segments.src: - **Using unofficial sites.** Enroll only through your exchange, your employer's benefits portal or a licensed agent or broker. Be cautious of unsolicited calls or messages asking for personal information.
segments.tr: - **गैर-आधिकारिक साइटों का उपयोग करना।** केवल अपने एक्सचेंज, अपने नियोक्ता के लाभ पोर्टल या लाइसेंस प्राप्त एजेंट या ब्रोकर के माध्यम से नामांकन करें। व्यक्तिगत जानकारी मांगने वाले अवांछित कॉल या संदेशों से सावधान रहें।

segments.src: ## Where to Get Help
segments.tr: ## सहायता कहाँ से प्राप्त करें

segments.src: Free, trained assistance is available.
segments.tr: निःशुल्क, प्रशिक्षित सहायता उपलब्ध है।

segments.src: Exchanges offer navigators and certified assistance counselors, and state insurance departments can answer questions about plans and complaints.
segments.tr: एक्सचेंज नेविगेटर और प्रमाणित सहायता परामर्शदाता प्रदान करते हैं, और राज्य बीमा विभाग प्लान और शिकायतों के बारे में प्रश्नों के उत्तर दे सकते हैं।

segments.src: Your employer's benefits office or human resources team can explain workplace options.
segments.tr: आपके नियोक्ता का लाभ कार्यालय या मानव संसाधन (HR) टीम कार्यस्थल के विकल्पों को समझा सकती है।

segments.src: ## The Bottom Line
segments.tr: ## निष्कर्ष

segments.src: Open enrollment rewards a little preparation.
segments.tr: ओपन एनरोलमेंट थोड़ी सी तैयारी का फल देता है।

segments.src: Gather your income details, list your doctors and prescriptions, note the deadlines that apply to you, and compare total expected costs rather than premiums alone.
segments.tr: अपनी आय का विवरण एकत्र करें, अपने डॉक्टरों और दवाओं की सूची बनाएं, आप पर लागू होने वाली समय-सीमा पर ध्यान दें, और केवल प्रीमियम के बजाय कुल अपेक्षित लागतों की तुलना करें।

segments.src: A review of an hour or two now can help you avoid surprises later.
segments.tr: अभी एक या दो घंटे की समीक्षा आपको बाद में आश्चर्य से बचने में मदद कर सकती है।

segments.src: *This article is for general information only and is not medical, legal, tax or financial advice.
segments.tr: *यह लेख केवल सामान्य जानकारी के लिए है और चिकित्सा, कानूनी, कर या वित्तीय सलाह नहीं है।

segments.src: Plan details, prices and eligibility rules change, so confirm current information with your exchange, insurer or employer before enrolling.*
segments.tr: प्लान के विवरण, कीमतें और पात्रता नियम बदलते रहते हैं, इसलिए नामांकन करने से पहले अपने एक्सचेंज, बीमाकर्ता या नियोक्ता के साथ वर्तमान जानकारी की पुष्टि करें।*

es.title: La inscripción abierta está a semanas de distancia: Qué comparar en primas, subsidios y opciones de planes

segments.src: Open enrollment is the yearly window when many people can sign up for health coverage or change the plan they already have.
segments.tr: La inscripción abierta es el período anual en el que muchas personas pueden inscribirse en una cobertura médica o cambiar el plan que ya tienen.

segments.src: For millions of households, the choices made over a few weeks will shape monthly budgets and out-of-pocket costs for the whole next year.
segments.tr: Para millones de hogares, las elecciones realizadas en pocas semanas determinarán los presupuestos mensuales y los gastos de bolsillo durante todo el próximo año.

segments.src: Details vary by employer, state and insurer, so treat the points below as a general guide and confirm specifics with official sources.
segments.tr: Los detalles varían según el empleador, el estado y la aseguradora, por lo que debe considerar los puntos siguientes como una guía general y confirmar los detalles específicos con fuentes oficiales.

segments.src: ## Two Enrollment Seasons, Two Sets of Rules
segments.tr: ## Dos temporadas de inscripción, dos conjuntos de reglas

segments.src: Most people fall into one of two groups.
segments.tr: La mayoría de las personas se encuentran en uno de dos grupos.

segments.src: - **Marketplace shoppers** buy individual coverage through HealthCare.gov or a state-run exchange. In most states, the federal window has typically opened on November 1. Some state exchanges run on different schedules, and the end date can differ, so check your own exchange's calendar.
segments.tr: - **Los compradores del mercado** adquieren cobertura individual a través de HealthCare.gov o de un intercambio administrado por el estado. En la mayoría de los estados, el período federal suele abrir el 1 de noviembre. Algunos intercambios estatales operan con calendarios diferentes y la fecha de finalización puede variar, así que consulte el calendario de su propio intercambio.

segments.src: - **Employer plan members** choose from the options their workplace offers. These windows are usually set by the employer, often in the fall, and can be short. Missing one may mean waiting until next year unless you have a qualifying life event.
segments.tr: - **Los miembros de planes de empleadores** eligen entre las opciones que ofrece su lugar de trabajo. Estas ventanas suelen ser establecidas por el empleador, a menudo en otoño, y pueden ser breves. Perder una puede significar esperar hasta el próximo año a menos que tenga un evento de vida calificado.

segments.src: Qualifying life events, such as losing other coverage, marriage, or the birth of a child, can open a separate special enrollment period.
segments.tr: Los eventos de vida calificados, como perder otra cobertura, casarse o el nacimiento de un hijo, pueden abrir un período de inscripción especial independiente.

segments.src: ## Premiums: Look Past the Sticker Price
segments.tr: ## Primas: Mire más allá del precio de etiqueta

segments.src: Insurers file proposed rates each year, and regulators review them.
segments.tr: Las aseguradoras presentan tarifas propuestas cada año y los reguladores las revisan.

segments.src: Whether your own premium goes up, down or stays flat depends on your insurer, county and plan.
segments.tr: Que su propia prima suba, baje o se mantenga igual depende de su aseguradora, condado y plan.

segments.src: Drivers commonly cited by insurers include medical costs, prescription drug spending and how many people are enrolled.
segments.tr: Los factores comúnmente citados por las aseguradoras incluyen los costos médicos, el gasto en medicamentos recetados y cuántas personas están inscritas.

segments.src: When you compare, keep these points in mind:
segments.tr: Cuando compare, tenga en cuenta estos puntos:

segments.src: 1. **The monthly premium is only one part of the cost.** A lower premium often comes with a higher deductible.
segments.tr: 1. **La prima mensual es solo una parte del costo.** Una prima más baja suele ir acompañada de un deducible más alto.

segments.src: 2. **Check the total picture.** Add up twelve months of premiums, then consider the deductible, copayments, coinsurance and the out-of-pocket maximum.
segments.tr: 2. **Revise el panorama completo.** Sume doce meses de primas, luego considere el deducible, los copagos, el coaseguro y el límite de gastos de bolsillo.

segments.src: 3. **Compare against your actual use.** If you expect regular specialist visits or ongoing prescriptions, a plan with a higher premium but lower cost-sharing may cost less overall.
segments.tr: 3. **Compare con su uso real.** Si espera visitas regulares a especialistas o recetas continuas, un plan con una prima más alta pero un costo compartido más bajo puede costarle menos en general.

segments.src: ## Subsidies: Re-Check Your Eligibility
segments.tr: ## Subsidios: vuelva a verificar su elegibilidad

segments.src: Marketplace premium tax credits reduce monthly premiums for eligible households.
segments.tr: Los créditos fiscales para primas del mercado reducen las primas mensuales para los hogares elegibles.

segments.src: The amount depends on household income, household size, the cost of benchmark plans in your area and the subsidy rules in effect for the year.
segments.tr: El monto depende de los ingresos del hogar, el tamaño del hogar, el costo de los planes de referencia en su área y las reglas de subsidio vigentes para el año.

segments.src: Because those rules have been subject to change by Congress, do not assume last year's help will look the same this year.
segments.tr: Debido a que esas reglas han estado sujetas a cambios por parte del Congreso, no asuma que la ayuda del año pasado será la misma este año.

segments.src: Practical steps:
segments.tr: Pasos prácticos:

segments.src: - **Update your application** with current income and household details instead of letting an old application renew automatically.
segments.tr: - **Actualice su solicitud** con los ingresos actuales y los detalles del hogar en lugar de dejar que una solicitud antigua se renueve automáticamente.

segments.src: - **Estimate income carefully.** Credits are generally reconciled when you file taxes, so a large gap between estimated and actual income can lead to owing money or receiving a larger refund.
segments.tr: - **Estime sus ingresos con cuidado.** Los créditos generalmente se reconcilian cuando presenta sus impuestos, por lo que una gran brecha entre los ingresos estimados y los reales puede llevar a deber dinero o recibir un reembolso mayor.

segments.src: - **Use the exchange's window-shopping or estimator tool** to see your likely cost before you commit.
segments.tr: - **Use la herramienta de comparación o estimación del intercambio** para ver su costo probable antes de comprometerse.

segments.src: - **Ask about other help**, such as cost-sharing reductions on certain silver-tier plans for lower-income enrollees, or Medicaid and CHIP, which are available year-round to those who qualify.
segments.tr: - **Pregunte sobre otra ayuda**, como reducciones de costos compartidos en ciertos planes de nivel plateado para inscritos de bajos ingresos, o Medicaid y CHIP, que están disponibles todo el año para quienes califiquen.

segments.src: ## Shrinking Plan Choices: What to Do If Your Plan Changes
segments.tr: ## Reducción de opciones de planes: qué hacer si su plan cambia

segments.src: In some areas, insurers leave markets, narrow their offerings or adjust their networks.
segments.tr: En algunas áreas, las aseguradoras abandonan los mercados, reducen sus ofertas o ajustan sus redes.

segments.src: Employers may also change carriers or benefit designs.
segments.tr: Los empleadores también pueden cambiar de proveedores o diseños de beneficios.

segments.src: If your current plan is discontinued or altered, you may be moved to a different plan automatically, and it may not match what you had.
segments.tr: Si su plan actual se discontinúa o se altera, es posible que lo cambien a un plan diferente automáticamente y es posible que no coincida con lo que tenía.

segments.src: - **Read your renewal notice** as soon as it arrives. It should describe changes to cost and coverage.
segments.tr: - **Lea su aviso de renovación** tan pronto como llegue. Debe describir los cambios en el costo y la cobertura.

segments.src: - **Verify your doctors and hospitals** are in the network of any plan you consider. Use the insurer's directory and, when possible, call the provider's office to confirm.
segments.tr: - **Verifique que sus médicos y hospitales** estén en la red de cualquier plan que considere. Utilice el directorio de la aseguradora y, cuando sea posible, llame al consultorio del proveedor para confirmar.

segments.src: - **Check the drug formulary** for each medication you take, including the tier it falls in and any prior authorization requirement.
segments.tr: - **Verifique el formulario de medicamentos** para cada medicamento que toma, incluido el nivel en el que se encuentra y cualquier requisito de autorización previa.

segments.src: - **Understand the network type.** HMO plans usually require referrals and in-network care. PPO plans offer more flexibility, often at a higher price.
segments.tr: - **Comprenda el tipo de red.** Los planes HMO generalmente requieren referencias y atención dentro de la red. Los planes PPO ofrecen más flexibilidad, a menudo a un precio más alto.

segments.src: ## A Simple Comparison Checklist
segments.tr: ## Una lista de verificación de comparación simple

segments.src: Before you choose, line up your top two or three options and compare:
segments.tr: Antes de elegir, alinee sus dos o tres opciones principales y compare:

segments.tr: | Pregunta | Por qué importa |

segments.tr: | Prima mensual después de cualquier subsidio | Su costo mensual fijo |

segments.src: | Deductible | What you pay before most coverage begins |
segments.tr: | Deducible | Lo que paga antes de que comience la mayor parte de la cobertura |

segments.src: | Out-of-pocket maximum | Your worst-case yearly spending on covered care |
segments.tr: | Máximo de bolsillo | Su gasto anual en el peor de los casos para la atención cubierta |

segments.tr: | Copagos y coaseguro | Su costo por visita o servicio |

segments.tr: | Red y referencias | Si sus proveedores están cubiertos |

segments.tr: | Cobertura de medicamentos | Costo de las recetas regulares |

segments.src: | HSA eligibility (if applicable) | Possible tax-advantaged savings with certain high-deductible plans |
segments.tr: | Elegibilidad para HSA (si corresponde) | Posibles ahorros con ventajas fiscales con ciertos planes de deducible alto |

segments.src: ## Employer Plans: Extra Items to Review
segments.tr: ## Planes de empleadores: elementos adicionales para revisar

segments.src: - **Employer contribution:** Compare how much your employer pays toward each option, since this can change the real cost gap between plans.
segments.tr: - **Contribución del empleador:** compare cuánto paga su empleador para cada opción, ya que esto puede cambiar la brecha de costo real entre los planes.

segments.src: - **Spouse and dependent coverage:** Family costs can rise sharply. Check whether a spouse's employer offers a better option.
segments.tr: - **Cobertura para cónyuge y dependientes:** los costos familiares pueden aumentar drásticamente. Verifique si el empleador de su cónyuge ofrece una mejor opción.

segments.src: - **FSA and HSA rules:** Flexible spending accounts often have use-it-or-lose-it limits. Review deadlines and carryover rules.
segments.tr: - **Reglas de FSA y HSA:** las cuentas de gastos flexibles a menudo tienen límites de úselo o piérdalo. Revise los plazos y las reglas de transferencia.

segments.src: - **Opt-out or surcharge rules:** Some employers charge extra if a covered spouse has other coverage available.
segments.tr: - **Reglas de exclusión voluntaria o recargo:** algunos empleadores cobran extra si el cónyuge cubierto tiene otra cobertura disponible.

segments.src: ## Avoiding Common Mistakes
segments.tr: ## Evitar errores comunes

segments.src: - **Waiting until the last day.** Websites can be slow near deadlines, and a missed date can leave you without coverage.
segments.tr: - **Esperar hasta el último día.** Los sitios web pueden ser lentos cerca de las fechas límite y una fecha perdida puede dejarlo sin cobertura.

segments.src: - **Auto-renewing without looking.** Premiums, networks and subsidy amounts may have changed.
segments.tr: - **Renovar automáticamente sin mirar.** Las primas, las redes y los montos de los subsidios pueden haber cambiado.

segments.src: - **Choosing on premium alone.** The cheapest plan can be the most expensive if you need significant care.
segments.tr: - **Elegir solo por la prima.** El plan más barato puede ser el más caro si necesita atención significativa.

segments.src: - **Using unofficial sites.** Enroll only through your exchange, your employer's benefits portal or a licensed agent or broker. Be cautious of unsolicited calls or messages asking for personal information.
segments.tr: - **Usar sitios no oficiales.** Inscríbase solo a través de su intercambio, el portal de beneficios de su empleador o un agente o corredor autorizado. Tenga cuidado con las llamadas o mensajes no solicitados que soliciten información personal.

segments.src: ## Where to Get Help
segments.tr: ## Dónde obtener ayuda

segments.src: Free, trained assistance is available.
segments.tr: Hay asistencia gratuita y capacitada disponible.

segments.src: Exchanges offer navigators and certified assistance counselors, and state insurance departments can answer questions about plans and complaints.
segments.tr: Los intercambios ofrecen navegadores y consejeros de asistencia certificados, y los departamentos de seguros estatales pueden responder preguntas sobre planes y quejas.

segments.src: Your employer's benefits office or human resources team can explain workplace options.
segments.tr: La oficina de beneficios o el equipo de recursos humanos de su empleador pueden explicarle las opciones del lugar de trabajo.

segments.src: ## The Bottom Line
segments.tr: ## El resultado final

segments.src: Open enrollment rewards a little preparation.
segments.tr: La inscripción abierta recompensa un poco de preparación.

segments.src: Gather your income details, list your doctors and prescriptions, note the deadlines that apply to you, and compare total expected costs rather than premiums alone.
segments.tr: Reúna los detalles de sus ingresos, enumere sus médicos y recetas, anote los plazos que se aplican a usted y compare los costos totales esperados en lugar de solo las primas.

segments.src: A review of an hour or two now can help you avoid surprises later.
segments.tr: Una revisión de una o dos horas ahora puede ayudarlo a evitar sorpresas más adelante.

ar.title: التسجيل المفتوح يبقله أسابيع: ما الذي يجب مقارنته بشأن الأقساط والإعانات وخيارات الخطط

segments.src: Open enrollment is the yearly window when many people can sign up for health coverage or change the plan they already have.
segments.tr: التسجيل المفتوح هو النافذة السنوية التي يمكن للعديد من الأشخاص خلالها التسجيل للحصول على التغطية الصحية أو تغيير الخطة التي لديهم بالفعل.

segments.src: For millions of households, the choices made over a few weeks will shape monthly budgets and out-of-pocket costs for the whole next year.
segments.tr: بالنسبة لملايين العائلات، فإن الخيارات المتخذة خلال بأسابيع قليلة ستشكل الميزانيات الشهرية والتكاليف النقدية للعام المقبل بأكمله.

segments.src: Details vary by employer, state and insurer, so treat the points below as a general guide and confirm specifics with official sources.
segments.tr: تختلف التفاصيل حسب صاحب العمل، الولاية وشركات التأمين، لذا تعامل مع النقاط أدناه كدليل عام وقم بتأكيد التفاصيل مع المصادر الرسمية.

segments.src: ## Two Enrollment Seasons, Two Sets of Rules
segments.tr: ## موسما تسجيل، ومجموعتان من القواعد

segments.src: Most people fall into one of two groups.
segments.tr: يقع معظم الناس في واحدة من مجموعتين.

segments.src: - **Marketplace shoppers** buy individual coverage through HealthCare.gov or a state-run exchange. In most states, the federal window has typically opened on November 1. Some state exchanges run on different schedules, and the end date can differ, so check your own exchange's calendar.
segments.tr: - **المتسوقون في السوق** يشترون تغطية فردية من خلال HealthCare.gov أو بورصة تديرها الولاية. في معظم الولايات، فتحت النافذة الفيدرالية عادة في 1 نوفمبر. تعمل بعض بورصات الولايات على جداول زمنية مختلفة، ويمكن أن يختلف تاريخ النهاية، لذا تحقق من تقويم البورصة الخاصة بك.

segments.src: - **Employer plan members** choose from the options their workplace offers. These windows are usually set by the employer, often in the fall, and can be short. Missing one may mean waiting until next year unless you have a qualifying life event.
segments.tr: - **أعضاء خطط أصحاب العمل** يختارون من بين الخيارات التي يقدمها مكان العمل. عادة ما يتم تحديد هذه النوافذ من قبل صاحب العمل، وغالباً ما تكون في الخريف، وقد تكون قصيرة. قد يعني تفويت إحداها الانتظار حتى العام المقبل إلا إذا كان لديك حدث حياة مؤهل.

segments.src: Qualifying life events, such as losing other coverage, marriage, or the birth of a child, can open a separate special enrollment period.
segments.tr: أحداث الحياة المؤهلة، مثل فقدان تغطية أخرى، الزواج، أو ولادة طفل، يمكن أن تفتح فترة تسجيل خاصة منفصلة.

segments.src: ## Premiums: Look Past the Sticker Price
segments.tr: ## الأقساط: انظر إلى ما وراء السعر المعلن

segments.src: Insurers file proposed rates each year, and regulators review them.
segments.tr: تقدم شركات التأمين الأسعار المقترحة كل عام، ويقوم المنظمون مراجعتها.

segments.src: Whether your own premium goes up, down or stays flat depends on your insurer, county and plan.
segments.tr: سواء كان قسطك يرتفع، ينخفض أو يبقى ثابتاً يعتمد على شركة التأمين الخاصة بك، المقاطعة والخطة.

segments.src: Drivers commonly cited by insurers include medical costs, prescription drug spending and how many people are enrolled.
segments.tr: تشمل الدوافع التي يذكرها عادة شركات التأمين التكاليف الطبية، الإنفاق على الأدوية الموصوفة وكم عدد الأشخاص المسجلين.

segments.src: When you compare, keep these points in mind:
segments.tr: عندما تقارن، ضع هذه النقاط في الاعتبار:

segments.src: 1. **The monthly premium is only one part of the cost.** A lower premium often comes with a higher deductible.
segments.tr: 1. **القسط الشهري هو مجرد جزء واحد من التكلفة.** غالباً ما يأتي القسط الأقل مع خصم أعلى.

segments.src: 2. **Check the total picture.** Add up twelve months of premiums, then consider the deductible, copayments, coinsurance and the out-of-pocket maximum.
segments.tr: 2. **تحقق من الصورة الكاملة.** اجمع اثني عشر شهراً من الأقساط، ثم ضع في اعتبارك الخصم، المدفوعات المشتركة، التأمين المشترك والحد الأقصى للدفع من الجيب.

segments.src: 3. **Compare against your actual use.** If you expect regular specialist visits or ongoing prescriptions, a plan with a higher premium but lower cost-sharing may cost less overall.
segments.tr: 3. **قارن مقابل استخدامك الفعلي.** إذا كنت تتوقع زيارات متخصصة منتظمة أو وصفات طبية مستمرة، فقد تكلف الخطة ذات القسط الأعلى ولكن تقاسم التكلفة الأقل أقل بشكل عام.

segments.src: ## Subsidies: Re-Check Your Eligibility
segments.tr: ## الإعانات: إعادة التحقق من أهلستك

segments.src: Marketplace premium tax credits reduce monthly premiums for eligible households.
segments.tr: تخفض الائتمانات الضريبية لأقساط السوق الأقساط الشهرية للأسر المؤهلة.

segments.src: The amount depends on household income, household size, the cost of benchmark plans in your area and the subsidy rules in effect for the year.
segments.tr: يعتمد المبلغ على دخل الأسرة، حجم الأسرة، تكلفة الخطط المرجعية في منطقتك وقواعد الإعانة السارية للعام.

segments.src: Because those rules have been subject to change by Congress, do not assume last year's help will look the same this year.
segments.tr: نظراً لأن هذه القواعد كانت عرضة للتغيير من قبل الكونغرس، فلا يفترض أن مساعدة العام الماضي تبدو نفس هذا العام.

segments.src: Practical steps:
segments.tr: خطوات عملية:

segments.src: - **Update your application** with current income and household details instead of letting an old application renew automatically.
segments.tr: - **تحديث طلبك** بالدخل الحالي وتفاصيل الأسرة بدلاً من السماح لتطبيق القديم بالتجديد تلقائياً.

segments.src: - **Estimate income carefully.** Credits are generally reconciled when you file taxes, so a large gap between estimated and actual income can lead to owing money or receiving a larger refund.
segments.tr: - **تقدير الدخل بعناية.** يتم عادة تسوية الاعتمادات عند تقديم الضرائب، لذا فإن الفجوة الكبيرة بين الدخل المقدر والفعلي يمكن أن تؤدي إلى مدين المال أو تلقي استرداد أكبر.

segments.src: - **Use the exchange's window-shopping or estimator tool** to see your likely cost before you commit.
segments.tr: - **استخدم أداة التسوق عبر نافذة البورصة أو أداة التقدير** لرؤية تكلفتك المحتملة قبل أن تلتزم.

segments.src: - **Ask about other help**, such as cost-sharing reductions on certain silver-tier plans for lower-income enrollees, or Medicaid and CHIP, which are available year-round to those who qualify.
segments.tr: - **اسأل عن المساعدة الأخرى**، مثل تخفيضات تقاسم التكلفة على خطط الفئة الفضية المعينة للمسجلين ذوي الدخل المنخفض، أو Medicaid و CHIP، والتي تتاح على مدار العام لأولئك الذين يؤهلون.

segments.src: ## Shrinking Plan Choices: What to Do If Your Plan Changes
segments.tr: ## تقليص خيارات الخطط: ماذا تفعل إذا تغيرت خطتك

segments.src: In some areas, insurers leave markets, narrow their offerings or adjust their networks.
segments.tr: في بعض المناطق، تترك شركات التأمين الأسواق، وتضيق عروضها أو تعدل شبكاتها.

segments.src: Employers may also change carriers or benefit designs.
segments.tr: قد يغير أصحاب العمل أيضاً شركات النقل أو تصاميم المزايا.

segments.src: If your current plan is discontinued or altered, you may be moved to a different plan automatically, and it may not match what you had.
segments.tr: إذا تم إلغاء خطتك الحالية أو تغييرها، قد يتم نقل إلى خطة مختلفة تلقائياً، وقد لا تطابق ما لديك.

segments.src: - **Read your renewal notice** as soon as it arrives. It should describe changes to cost and coverage.
segments.tr: - **اقرأ إشعار التجديد** بمجرد وصوله. يجب أن يصف التغيرات في التكلفة والتغطية.

segments.src: - **Verify your doctors and hospitals** are in the network of any plan you consider. Use the insurer's directory and, when possible, call the provider's office to confirm.
segments.tr: - **تحقق من أطبائك المستشفيات** في شبكة أي خطة تفكر فيها. استخدم دليل شركة التأمين، وعند الإمكان، اتصل بمكتب المزود للتأكيد.

segments.src: - **Check the drug formulary** for each medication you take, including the tier it falls in and any prior authorization requirement.
segments.tr: - **تحقق من صيغة الأدوية** لكل دواء تتناوله، بما في ذلك الطبقة التي يقع فيها وأي متطلبات تفويض مسبق.

segments.src: - **Understand the network type.** HMO plans usually require referrals and in-network care. PPO plans offer more flexibility, often at a higher price.
segments.tr: - **فهم نوع الشبكة.** تتطلب خطط HMO عادة الإحالات والرعاية داخل الشبكة. توفر خطط PPO مرونة أكبر، غالباً بسعر أعلى.

segments.tr: | القسط الشهري بعد أي إعانة | تكلفتك الشهرية الثابتة |

segments.tr: | المدفوعات المشتركة والتأمين المشترك | تكلفتك لكل زيارة أو خدمة |

segments.tr: | الشبكة والإحالات | ما إذا كان مزودوك مغطى |

segments.tr: | تغطية الأدوية | تكلفة الوصفات المنتظمة |

segments.src: ## Employer Plans: Extra Items to Review
segments.tr: ## خطط أصحاب العمل: عناصر إضافية للمراجعة

segments.src: - **Employer contribution:** Compare how much your employer pays toward each option, since this can change the real cost gap between plans.
segments.tr: - **مساهمة صاحب العمل:** قارن كم يدفع صاحب العمل تجاه كل خيار، حيث يمكن أن يغير هذا فجوة التكلفة الحقيقية بين الخطط.

segments.src: - **Spouse and dependent coverage:** Family costs can rise sharply. Check whether a spouse's employer offers a better option.
segments.tr: - **تغطية الزوج والمعالين:** يمكن أن ترتفع تكاليف الأسرة بشكل حاد. تحقق مما إذا كان صاحب العمل للزوج يقدم خياراً أفضل.

segments.src: - **FSA and HSA rules:** Flexible spending accounts often have use-it-or-lose-it limits. Review deadlines and carryover rules.
segments.tr: - **قواعد FSA و HSA:** غالباً ما يكون لحسابات الإنفاق المرن حدود الاستخدام أو الضياع. راجع المواعيد النهائية وقواعد الترحيل.

segments.src: - **Opt-out or surcharge rules:** Some employers charge extra if a covered spouse has other coverage available.
segments.tr: - **قواعد الانسحاب أو الرسوم الإضافية:** يتقاضى بعض أصحاب العمل تكلفة إضافية إذا كان لدى الزوج المغطى تغطية أخرى متاحة.

segments.src: ## Avoiding Common Mistakes
segments.tr: ## تجنب الأخطاء الشائعة

segments.src: - **Waiting until the last day.** Websites can be slow near deadlines, and a missed date can leave you without coverage.
segments.tr: - **الانتظار حتى اليوم الأخير.** يمكن أن تكون مواقع الويب بطيئة بالقرب من المواعيد النهائية، والتاريخ الفائت يمكن أن يتركك بدون تغطية.

segments.src: - **Auto-renewing without looking.** Premiums, networks and subsidy amounts may have changed.
segments.tr: - **التجديد التلقائي بدون النظر.** ربما تغيرت الأقساط، الشبكات ومبالغ الإعانات.

segments.src: - **Choosing on premium alone.** The cheapest plan can be the most expensive if you need significant care.
segments.tr: - **الاختيار بناءً على القسط وحده.** يمكن أن تكون الخطة الأرخص هي الأكثر تكلفة إذا كنت بحاجة إلى رعاية كبيرة.

segments.src: - **Using unofficial sites.** Enroll only through your exchange, your employer's benefits portal or a licensed agent or broker. Be cautious of unsolicited calls or messages asking for personal information.
segments.tr: - **استخدام مواقع غير رسمية.** سجل فقط من خلال البورصة الخاصة بك، أو بوابة مزايا صاحب العمل، أو وكيل أو وسيط مرخص. كن حذراً من المكالمات أو الرسائل غير المعتادة التي تطلب معلومات شخصية.

segments.src: ## Where to Get Help
segments.tr: ## أين تحصل على المساعدة

segments.src: Free, trained assistance is available.
segments.tr: المساعدة المجانية والمدربة متاحة.

segments.src: Exchanges offer navigators and certified assistance counselors, and state insurance departments can answer questions about plans and complaints.
segments.tr: تقدم البورصات ملاحين ومستشاري مساعدة معتمدين، ويمكن لإدارات التأمين في الولاية الإجابة عن الأسئلة المتعلقة بالخطط والشكاوى.

segments.src: Your employer's benefits office or human resources team can explain workplace options.
segments.tr: يمكن لمكتب مزايا صاحب العمل أو فريق الموارد البشرية شرح خيارات مكان العمل.

segments.src: ## The Bottom Line
segments.tr: ## الخلاصة

segments.src: Open enrollment rewards a little preparation.
segments.tr: يكافئ التسجيل المفتوح القليل من التحضير.

segments.src: Gather your income details, list your doctors and prescriptions, note the deadlines that apply to you, and compare total expected costs rather than premiums alone.
segments.tr: اجمع تفاصيل دخلك، واكتب أطبائك ووصفاتك الطبية، ولاحظ المواعيد النهائية التي تنطبق عليك، وقارن إجمالي التكاليف المتوقعة بدلاً من الأقساط وحدها.

segments.src: A review of an hour or two now can help you avoid surprises later.
segments.tr: مراجعة لمدة ساعة أو ساعتين الآن يمكن أن تساعدك في تجنب المفاجآت لاحقاً.
