fr.title: La période d'inscription ouverte approche : que comparer en matière de primes, de subventions et de choix de régimes

segments.src: Open enrollment is the yearly window when many people can sign up for health coverage or change the plan they already have.
segments.tr: La période d'inscription ouverte est la fenêtre annuelle pendant laquelle de nombreuses personnes peuvent souscrire à une assurance maladie ou modifier le régime qu'elles possèdent déjà.

segments.src: For millions of households, the choices made over a few weeks will shape monthly budgets and out-of-pocket costs for the whole next year.
segments.tr: Pour des millions de foyers, les choix faits en quelques semaines façonneront les budgets mensuels et les frais à la charge des patients pour toute l'année suivante.

segments.src: Details vary by employer, state and insurer, so treat the points below as a general guide and confirm specifics with official sources.
segments.tr: Les détails varient selon l'employeur, l'État et l'assureur, veuillez donc considérer les points ci-dessous comme un guide général et confirmer les spécificités auprès des sources officielles.

segments.src: ## Two Enrollment Seasons, Two Sets of Rules
segments.tr: ## Deux saisons d'inscription, deux ensembles de règles

segments.src: Most people fall into one of two groups.
segments.tr: La plupart des gens appartiennent à l'un de ces deux groupes.

segments.src: - **Marketplace shoppers** buy individual coverage through HealthCare.gov or a state-run exchange. In most states, the federal window has typically opened on November 1. Some state exchanges run on different schedules, and the end date can differ, so check your own exchange's calendar.
segments.tr: - **Les acheteurs de la place de marché** souscrivent à une couverture individuelle via HealthCare.gov ou une bourse gérée par l'État. Dans la plupart des États, la période fédérale s'ouvre généralement le 1er novembre. Certaines bourses d'État fonctionnent selon des calendriers différents et la date de fin peut varier, veuillez donc consulter le calendrier de votre propre bourse.

segments.src: - **Employer plan members** choose from the options their workplace offers. These windows are usually set by the employer, often in the fall, and can be short. Missing one may mean waiting until next year unless you have a qualifying life event.
segments.tr: - **Les membres de régimes d'entreprise** choisissent parmi les options proposées par leur lieu de travail. Ces périodes sont généralement fixées par l'employeur, souvent en automne, et peuvent être courtes. En manquer une peut signifier devoir attendre l'année prochaine, sauf si vous vivez un événement de vie admissible.

segments.src: Qualifying life events, such as losing other coverage, marriage, or the birth of a child, can open a separate special enrollment period.
segments.tr: Les événements de vie admissibles, tels que la perte d'une autre couverture, le mariage ou la naissance d'un enfant, peuvent ouvrir une période d'inscription spéciale distincte.

segments.src: ## Premiums: Look Past the Sticker Price
segments.tr: ## Primes : regardez au-delà du prix affiché

segments.src: Insurers file proposed rates each year, and regulators review them.
segments.tr: Les assureurs déposent des propositions de tarifs chaque année et les régulateurs les examinent.

segments.src: Whether your own premium goes up, down or stays flat depends on your insurer, county and plan.
segments.tr: Que votre propre prime augmente, diminue ou reste stable dépend de votre assureur, de votre comté et de votre régime.

segments.src: Drivers commonly cited by insurers include medical costs, prescription drug spending and how many people are enrolled.
segments.tr: Les facteurs fréquemment cités par les assureurs comprennent les frais médicaux, les dépenses en médicaments sur ordonnance et le nombre de personnes inscrites.

segments.src: When you compare, keep these points in mind:
segments.tr: Lorsque vous comparez, gardez ces points à l'esprit :

segments.src: 1. **The monthly premium is only one part of the cost.** A lower premium often comes with a higher deductible.
segments.tr: 1. **La prime mensuelle n'est qu'une partie du coût.** Une prime plus basse s'accompagne souvent d'une franchise plus élevée.

segments.src: 2. **Check the total picture.** Add up twelve months of premiums, then consider the deductible, copayments, coinsurance and the out-of-pocket maximum.
segments.tr: 2. **Vérifiez l'ensemble de la situation.** Additionnez douze mois de primes, puis tenez compte de la franchise, des co-paiements, de la coassurance et du maximum à la charge du patient.

segments.src: 3. **Compare against your actual use.** If you expect regular specialist visits or ongoing prescriptions, a plan with a higher premium but lower cost-sharing may cost less overall.
segments.tr: 3. **Comparez par rapport à votre utilisation réelle.** Si vous prévoyez des visites régulières chez des spécialistes ou des ordonnances continues, un régime avec une prime plus élevée mais un partage des coûts plus faible peut s'avérer moins cher au total.

segments.src: ## Subsidies: Re-Check Your Eligibility
segments.tr: ## Subventions : revoyez votre admissibilité

segments.src: Marketplace premium tax credits reduce monthly premiums for eligible households.
segments.tr: Les crédits d'impôt sur les primes de la place de marché réduisent les primes mensuelles pour les ménages admissibles.

segments.src: The amount depends on household income, household size, the cost of benchmark plans in your area and the subsidy rules in effect for the year.
segments.tr: Le montant dépend du revenu du ménage, de la taille du ménage, du coût des régimes de référence dans votre région et des règles de subvention en vigueur pour l'année.

segments.src: Because those rules have been subject to change by Congress, do not assume last year's help will look the same this year.
segments.tr: Étant donné que ces règles ont pu être modifiées par le Congrès, ne présumez pas que l'aide de l'année dernière sera la même cette année.

segments.src: Practical steps:
segments.tr: Étapes pratiques :

segments.src: - **Update your application** with current income and household details instead of letting an old application renew automatically.
segments.tr: - **Mettez à jour votre demande** avec vos revenus actuels et les détails de votre ménage au lieu de laisser une ancienne demande se renouveler automatiquement.

segments.src: - **Estimate income carefully.** Credits are generally reconciled when you file taxes, so a large gap between estimated and actual income can lead to owing money or receiving a larger refund.
segments.tr: - **Estimez soigneusement vos revenus.** Les crédits sont généralement rapprochés lorsque vous déclarez vos impôts, un grand écart entre les revenus estimés et réels peut donc vous amener à devoir de l'argent ou à recevoir un remboursement plus important.

segments.src: - **Use the exchange's window-shopping or estimator tool** to see your likely cost before you commit.
segments.tr: - **Utilisez l'outil d'estimation ou de lèche-vitrine de la bourse** pour voir votre coût probable avant de vous engager.

segments.src: - **Ask about other help**, such as cost-sharing reductions on certain silver-tier plans for lower-income enrollees, or Medicaid and CHIP, which are available year-round to those who qualify.
segments.tr: - **Renseignez-vous sur d'autres aides**, telles que les réductions du partage des coûts sur certains régimes de niveau argent pour les inscrits à faible revenu, ou Medicaid et CHIP, qui sont disponibles toute l'année pour ceux qui y ont droit.

segments.src: ## Shrinking Plan Choices: What to Do If Your Plan Changes
segments.tr: ## Réduction des choix de régimes : que faire si votre régime change

segments.src: In some areas, insurers leave markets, narrow their offerings or adjust their networks.
segments.tr: Dans certaines régions, les assureurs quittent les marchés, restreignent leurs offres ou ajustent leurs réseaux.

segments.src: Employers may also change carriers or benefit designs.
segments.tr: Les employeurs peuvent également changer de transporteur ou de conception des prestations.

segments.src: If your current plan is discontinued or altered, you may be moved to a different plan automatically, and it may not match what you had.
segments.tr: Si votre régime actuel est interrompu ou modifié, vous pouvez être transféré automatiquement vers un autre régime, et il se peut qu'il ne corresponde pas à ce que vous aviez.

segments.src: - **Read your renewal notice** as soon as it arrives. It should describe changes to cost and coverage.
segments.tr: - **Lisez votre avis de renouvellement** dès son arrivée. Il doit décrire les modifications apportées au coût et à la couverture.

segments.src: - **Verify your doctors and hospitals** are in the network of any plan you consider. Use the insurer's directory and, when possible, call the provider's office to confirm.
segments.tr: - **Vérifiez que vos médecins et hôpitaux** figurent dans le réseau de tout régime que vous envisagez. Utilisez l'annuaire de l'assureur et, si possible, appelez le cabinet du fournisseur pour le confirmer.

segments.src: - **Check the drug formulary** for each medication you take, including the tier it falls in and any prior authorization requirement.
segments.tr: - **Consultez la liste des médicaments** pour chaque médicament que vous prenez, y compris le niveau auquel il se trouve et toute exigence d'autorisation préalable.

segments.src: - **Understand the network type.** HMO plans usually require referrals and in-network care. PPO plans offer more flexibility, often at a higher price.
segments.tr: - **Comprenez le type de réseau.** Les régimes HMO exigent généralement des références et des soins au sein du réseau. Les régimes PPO offrent plus de flexibilité, souvent à un prix plus élevé.

segments.src: ## A Simple Comparison Checklist
segments.tr: ## Une liste de contrôle de comparaison simple

segments.src: Before you choose, line up your top two or three options and compare:
segments.tr: Avant de choisir, alignez vos deux ou trois meilleures options et comparez :

segments.src: | Question | Why it matters |
segments.tr: | Question | Pourquoi c'est important |

segments.src: | Monthly premium after any subsidy | Your fixed monthly cost |
segments.tr: | Prime mensuelle après toute subvention | Votre coût mensuel fixe |

segments.src: | Deductible | What you pay before most coverage begins |
segments.tr: | Franchise | Ce que vous payez avant que la plupart des couvertures ne commencent |

segments.src: | Out-of-pocket maximum | Your worst-case yearly spending on covered care |
segments.tr: | Maximum à la charge du patient | Vos dépenses annuelles maximales pour les soins couverts |

segments.src: | Copays and coinsurance | Your cost per visit or service |
segments.tr: | Co-paiements et coassurance | Votre coût par visite ou service |

segments.src: | Network and referrals | Whether your providers are covered |
segments.tr: | Réseau et références | Si vos fournisseurs sont couverts |

segments.src: | Drug coverage | Cost of regular prescriptions |
segments.tr: | Couverture des médicaments | Coût des ordonnances régulières |

segments.src: | HSA eligibility (if applicable) | Possible tax-advantaged savings with certain high-deductible plans |
segments.tr: | Admissibilité au HSA (le cas échéant) | Économies possibles fiscalement avantagées avec certains régimes à franchise élevée |

segments.src: ## Employer Plans: Extra Items to Review
segments.tr: ## Régimes d'entreprise : éléments supplémentaires à examiner

segments.src: - **Employer contribution:** Compare how much your employer pays toward each option, since this can change the real cost gap between plans.
segments.tr: - **Contribution de l'employeur :** comparez le montant versé par votre employeur pour chaque option, car cela peut modifier l'écart de coût réel entre les régimes.

segments.src: - **Spouse and dependent coverage:** Family costs can rise sharply. Check whether a spouse's employer offers a better option.
segments.tr: - **Couverture du conjoint et des personnes à charge :** les coûts familiaux peuvent augmenter considérablement. Vérifiez si le régime de l'employeur d'un conjoint offre une meilleure option.

segments.src: - **FSA and HSA rules:** Flexible spending accounts often have use-it-or-lose-it limits. Review deadlines and carryover rules.
segments.tr: - **Règles FSA et HSA :** les comptes de dépenses flexibles ont souvent des limites d'utilisation ou de perte. Examinez les délais et les règles de report.

segments.src: - **Opt-out or surcharge rules:** Some employers charge extra if a covered spouse has other coverage available.
segments.tr: - **Règles de désistement ou de surprime :** certains employeurs facturent un supplément si un conjoint couvert dispose d'une autre couverture.

segments.src: ## Avoiding Common Mistakes
segments.tr: ## Éviter les erreurs courantes

segments.src: - **Waiting until the last day.** Websites can be slow near deadlines, and a missed date can leave you without coverage.
segments.tr: - **Attendre le dernier jour.** Les sites Web peuvent être lents près des dates limites, et une date manquée peut vous laisser sans couverture.

segments.src: - **Auto-renewing without looking.** Premiums, networks and subsidy amounts may have changed.
segments.tr: - **Se renouveler automatiquement sans regarder.** Les primes, les réseaux et les montants des subventions peuvent avoir changé.

segments.src: - **Choosing on premium alone.** The cheapest plan can be the most expensive if you need significant care.
segments.tr: - **Choisir uniquement en fonction de la prime.** Le régime le moins cher peut être le plus cher si vous avez besoin de soins importants.

segments.src: - **Using unofficial sites.** Enroll only through your exchange, your employer's benefits portal or a licensed agent or broker. Be cautious of unsolicited calls or messages asking for personal information.
segments.tr: - **Utiliser des sites non officiels.** Inscrivez-vous uniquement par l'intermédiaire de votre bourse, du portail des avantages sociaux de votre employeur ou d'un agent ou courtier agréé. Méfiez-vous des appels ou des messages non sollicités demandant des informations personnelles.

segments.src: ## Where to Get Help
segments.tr: ## Où obtenir de l'aide

segments.src: Free, trained assistance is available.
segments.tr: Une assistance gratuite et qualifiée est disponible.

segments.src: Exchanges offer navigators and certified assistance counselors, and state insurance departments can answer questions about plans and complaints.
segments.tr: Les bourses offrent des navigateurs et des conseillers d'assistance certifiés, et les départements d'assurance des États peuvent répondre aux questions sur les régimes et les plaintes.

segments.src: Your employer's benefits office or human resources team can explain workplace options.
segments.tr: Le bureau des avantages sociaux ou l'équipe des ressources humaines de votre employeur peut vous expliquer les options disponibles sur le lieu de travail.

segments.src: ## The Bottom Line
segments.tr: ## L'essentiel

segments.src: Open enrollment rewards a little preparation.
segments.tr: L'inscription ouverte récompense un peu de préparation.

segments.src: Gather your income details, list your doctors and prescriptions, note the deadlines that apply to you, and compare total expected costs rather than premiums alone.
segments.tr: Rassemblez les détails de vos revenus, listez vos médecins et ordonnances, notez les dates limites qui s'appliquent à vous et comparez les coûts totaux prévus plutôt que les primes seules.

segments.src: A review of an hour or two now can help you avoid surprises later.
segments.tr: Une heure ou deux d'examen dès maintenant peuvent vous aider à éviter les surprises plus tard.

segments.tr: *Cet article est fourni à titre d'information générale uniquement et ne constitue pas un avis médical, juridique, fiscal ou financier.

segments.tr: ## Planos de Empregadores: Itens Extras para Revisar

segments.src: - **Employer contribution:** Compare how much your employer pays toward each option, since this can change the real cost gap between plans.
segments.tr: - **Contribuição do empregador:** Compare quanto seu empregador paga para cada opção, já que isso pode alterar a lacuna de custo real entre os planos.

segments.src: - **Spouse and dependent coverage:** Family costs can rise sharply. Check whether a spouse's employer offers a better option.
segments.tr: - **Cobertura de cônjuge e dependentes:** Os custos familiares podem subir acentuadamente. Verifique se o empregador de um cônjuge oferece uma opção melhor.

segments.src: - **FSA and HSA rules:** Flexible spending accounts often have use-it-or-lose-it limits. Review deadlines and carryover rules.
segments.tr: - **Regras de FSA e HSA:** Contas de gastos flexíveis geralmente têm limites de uso obrigatório. Revise prazos e regras de transferência.

segments.src: - **Opt-out or surcharge rules:** Some employers charge extra if a covered spouse has other coverage available.
segments.tr: - **Regras de recusa ou sobretaxa:** Alguns empregadores cobram a mais se um cônjuge coberto tiver outra cobertura disponível.

segments.src: ## Avoiding Common Mistakes
segments.tr: ## Evitando Erros Comuns

segments.src: - **Waiting until the last day.** Websites can be slow near deadlines, and a missed date can leave you without coverage.
segments.tr: - **Esperar até o último dia.** Os sites podem ser lentos perto dos prazos, e uma data perdida pode deixá-lo sem cobertura.

segments.src: - **Auto-renewing without looking.** Premiums, networks and subsidy amounts may have changed.
segments.tr: - **Renovar automaticamente sem olhar.** Prêmios, redes e valores de subsídio podem ter mudado.

segments.src: - **Choosing on premium alone.** The cheapest plan can be the most expensive if you need significant care.
segments.tr: - **Escolher apenas pelo prêmio.** O plano mais barato pode ser o mais caro se você precisar de atendimento significativo.

segments.src: - **Using unofficial sites.** Enroll only through your exchange, your employer's benefits portal or a licensed agent or broker. Be cautious of unsolicited calls or messages asking for personal information.
segments.tr: - **Usar sites não oficiais.** Inscreva-se apenas através da sua bolsa, portal de benefícios do seu empregador ou um agente ou corretor licenciado. Tenha cuidado com chamadas ou mensagens não solicitadas pedindo informações pessoais.

segments.src: ## Where to Get Help
segments.tr: ## Onde Obter Ajuda

segments.src: Free, trained assistance is available.
segments.tr: Assistência gratuita e treinada está disponível.

segments.src: Exchanges offer navigators and certified assistance counselors, and state insurance departments can answer questions about plans and complaints.
segments.tr: As bolsas oferecem navegadores e conselheiros de assistência certificados, e os departamentos de seguros estaduais podem responder a perguntas sobre planos e reclamações.

segments.src: Your employer's benefits office or human resources team can explain workplace options.
segments.tr: O escritório de benefícios do seu empregador ou equipe de recursos humanos pode explicar as opções do local de trabalho.

segments.src: ## The Bottom Line
segments.tr: ## O Fundo da Questão

segments.src: Open enrollment rewards a little preparation.
segments.tr: A inscrição aberta recompensa um pouco de preparação.

segments.src: Gather your income details, list your doctors and prescriptions, note the deadlines that apply to you, and compare total expected costs rather than premiums alone.
segments.tr: Reúna seus detalhes de renda, liste seus médicos e prescrições, anote os prazos que se aplicam a você e compare os custos totais esperados em vez de apenas os prêmios.

segments.src: A review of an hour or two now can help you avoid surprises later.
segments.tr: Uma revisão de uma ou duas horas agora pode ajudá-lo a evitar surpresas mais tarde.

segments.src: *This article is for general information only and is not medical, legal, tax or financial advice.
segments.tr: *Este artigo é apenas para informação geral e não constitui aconselhamento médico, jurídico, fiscal ou financeiro.

segments.src: Plan details, prices and eligibility rules change, so confirm current information with your exchange, insurer or employer before enrolling.*
segments.tr: Detalhes do plano, preços e regras de elegibilidade mudam, portanto, confirme as informações atuais com sua bolsa, seguradora ou empregador antes de se inscrever.*

in.title: Pendaftaran Terbuka Tinggal Beberapa Minggu Lagi: Apa yang Perlu Dibandingkan pada Premi, Subsidi, dan Pilihan Rencana

segments.src: Open enrollment is the yearly window when many people can sign up for health coverage or change the plan they already have.
segments.tr: Pendaftaran terbuka adalah jendela tahunan ketika banyak orang dapat mendaftar untuk cakupan kesehatan atau mengubah rencana yang sudah mereka miliki.

segments.src: For millions of households, the choices made over a few weeks will shape monthly budgets and out-of-pocket costs for the whole next year.
segments.tr: Bagi jutaan rumah tangga, pilihan yang dibuat selama beberapa minggu ini akan menentukan anggaran bulanan dan biaya yang harus dibayar sendiri untuk sepanjang tahun depan.

segments.src: Details vary by employer, state and insurer, so treat the points below as a general guide and confirm specifics with official sources.
segments.tr: Detailnya bervariasi berdasarkan pemberi kerja, negara bagian, dan perusahaan asuransi, jadi anggap poin-poin di bawah ini sebagai panduan umum dan konfirmasikan rincian spesifiknya dengan sumber resmi.

segments.src: ## Two Enrollment Seasons, Two Sets of Rules
segments.tr: ## Dua Musim Pendaftaran, Dua Set Aturan

segments.src: Most people fall into one of two groups.
segments.tr: Sebagian besar orang termasuk dalam salah satu dari dua kelompok.

segments.src: - **Marketplace shoppers** buy individual coverage through HealthCare.gov or a state-run exchange. In most states, the federal window has typically opened on November 1. Some state exchanges run on different schedules, and the end date can differ, so check your own exchange's calendar.
segments.tr: - **Pembeli pasar (Marketplace)** membeli cakupan individu melalui HealthCare.gov atau bursa yang dikelola negara bagian. Di sebagian besar negara bagian, jendela federal biasanya dibuka pada 1 November. Beberapa bursa negara bagian berjalan dengan jadwal yang berbeda, dan tanggal berakhirnya bisa berbeda, jadi periksalah kalender bursa Anda sendiri.

segments.src: - **Employer plan members** choose from the options their workplace offers. These windows are usually set by the employer, often in the fall, and can be short. Missing one may mean waiting until next year unless you have a qualifying life event.
segments.tr: - **Anggota rencana pemberi kerja** memilih dari opsi yang ditawarkan tempat kerja mereka. Jendela ini biasanya ditetapkan oleh pemberi kerja, sering kali di musim gugur, dan bisa berlangsung singkat. Melewatkannya mungkin berarti harus menunggu hingga tahun depan kecuali Anda memiliki peristiwa kehidupan yang memenuhi syarat.

segments.src: Qualifying life events, such as losing other coverage, marriage, or the birth of a child, can open a separate special enrollment period.
segments.tr: Peristiwa kehidupan yang memenuhi syarat, seperti kehilangan cakupan lain, pernikahan, atau kelahiran anak, dapat membuka periode pendaftaran khusus yang terpisah.

segments.src: ## Premiums: Look Past the Sticker Price
segments.tr: ## Premi: Lihat Melampaui Harga yang Tertera

segments.src: Insurers file proposed rates each year, and regulators review them.
segments.tr: Perusahaan asuransi mengajukan usulan tarif setiap tahun, dan regulator meninjaunya.

segments.src: Whether your own premium goes up, down or stays flat depends on your insurer, county and plan.
segments.tr: Apakah premi Anda sendiri naik, turun, atau tetap stabil tergantung pada perusahaan asuransi, wilayah, dan rencana Anda.

segments.src: Drivers commonly cited by insurers include medical costs, prescription drug spending and how many people are enrolled.
segments.tr: Faktor pendorong yang biasa dikutip oleh perusahaan asuransi meliputi biaya medis, pengeluaran obat resep, dan berapa banyak orang yang terdaftar.

segments.src: When you compare, keep these points in mind:
segments.tr: Saat Anda membandingkan, ingatlah poin-poin ini:

segments.src: 1. **The monthly premium is only one part of the cost.** A lower premium often comes with a higher deductible.
segments.tr: 1. **Premi bulanan hanyalah salah satu bagian dari biaya.** Premi yang lebih rendah sering kali disertai dengan deduktibel yang lebih tinggi.

segments.src: 2. **Check the total picture.** Add up twelve months of premiums, then consider the deductible, copayments, coinsurance and the out-of-pocket maximum.
segments.tr: 2. **Periksa gambaran totalnya.** Jumlahkan premi selama dua belas bulan, lalu pertimbangkan deduktibel, koinasuransi, kofasilitas (copayment), dan batas maksimum biaya sendiri (out-of-pocket maximum).

segments.src: 3. **Compare against your actual use.** If you expect regular specialist visits or ongoing prescriptions, a plan with a higher premium but lower cost-sharing may cost less overall.
segments.tr: 3. **Bandingkan dengan penggunaan aktual Anda.** Jika Anda memperkirakan kunjungan spesialis secara teratur atau resep yang berkelanjutan, rencana dengan premi lebih tinggi tetapi pembagian biaya yang lebih rendah mungkin secara keseluruhan memakan biaya lebih sedikit.

segments.src: ## Subsidies: Re-Check Your Eligibility
segments.tr: ## Subsidi: Periksa Kembali Kelayakan Anda

segments.src: Marketplace premium tax credits reduce monthly premiums for eligible households.
segments.tr: Kredit pajak premi pasar mengurangi premi bulanan untuk rumah tangga yang memenuhi syarat.

segments.src: The amount depends on household income, household size, the cost of benchmark plans in your area and the subsidy rules in effect for the year.
segments.tr: Jumlahnya tergantung pada pendapatan rumah tangga, ukuran rumah tangga, biaya rencana tolok ukur (benchmark) di wilayah Anda, dan aturan subsidi yang berlaku untuk tahun tersebut.

segments.src: Because those rules have been subject to change by Congress, do not assume last year's help will look the same this year.
segments.tr: Karena aturan tersebut dapat berubah oleh Kongres, jangan berasumsi bahwa bantuan tahun lalu akan terlihat sama tahun ini.

segments.src: Practical steps:
segments.tr: Langkah praktis:

segments.src: - **Update your application** with current income and household details instead of letting an old application renew automatically.
segments.tr: - **Perbarui aplikasi Anda** dengan pendapatan saat ini dan detail rumah tangga alih-alih membiarkan aplikasi lama diperpanjang secara otomatis.

segments.src: - **Estimate income carefully.** Credits are generally reconciled when you file taxes, so a large gap between estimated and actual income can lead to owing money or receiving a larger refund.
segments.tr: - **Perkirakan pendapatan dengan cermat.** Kredit umumnya disesuaikan saat Anda melaporkan pajak, sehingga selisih besar antara perkiraan dan pendapatan aktual dapat menyebabkan Anda berutang uang atau menerima pengembalian dana yang lebih besar.

segments.src: - **Use the exchange's window-shopping or estimator tool** to see your likely cost before you commit.
segments.tr: - **Gunakan alat simulasi belanja atau estimator bursa** untuk melihat kemungkinan biaya Anda sebelum Anda berkomitmen.

segments.src: - **Ask about other help**, such as cost-sharing reductions on certain silver-tier plans for lower-income enrollees, or Medicaid and CHIP, which are available year-round to those who qualify.
segments.tr: - **Tanyakan tentang bantuan lain**, seperti pengurangan pembagian biaya pada rencana tingkat perak (silver-tier) tertentu untuk pendaftar berpenghasilan rendah, atau Medicaid dan CHIP, yang tersedia sepanjang tahun bagi mereka yang memenuhi syarat.

segments.src: ## Shrinking Plan Choices: What to Do If Your Plan Changes
segments.tr: ## Pilihan Rencana yang Menyusut: Apa yang Harus Dilakukan Jika Rencana Anda Berubah

segments.src: In some areas, insurers leave markets, narrow their offerings or adjust their networks.
segments.tr: Di beberapa wilayah, perusahaan asuransi keluar dari pasar, mempersempit penawaran mereka, atau menyesuaikan jaringan mereka.

segments.src: Employers may also change carriers or benefit designs.
segments.tr: Pemberi kerja juga dapat mengubah operator atau desain manfaat.

segments.src: If your current plan is discontinued or altered, you may be moved to a different plan automatically, and it may not match what you had.
segments.tr: Jika rencana Anda saat ini dihentikan atau diubah, Anda mungkin akan dipindahkan ke rencana yang berbeda secara otomatis, dan itu mungkin tidak cocok dengan apa yang Anda miliki sebelumnya.

segments.src: - **Read your renewal notice** as soon as it arrives. It should describe changes to cost and coverage.
segments.tr: - **Baca pemberitahuan perpanjangan Anda** segera setelah tiba. Surat tersebut harus menjelaskan perubahan pada biaya dan cakupan.

segments.src: - **Verify your doctors and hospitals** are in the network of any plan you consider. Use the insurer's directory and, when possible, call the provider's office to confirm.
segments.tr: - **Verifikasi dokter dan rumah sakit Anda** masuk dalam jaringan rencana apa pun yang Anda pertimbangkan. Gunakan direktori perusahaan asuransi dan, jika memungkinkan, hubungi kantor penyedia layanan untuk mengonfirmasi.

segments.src: - **Check the drug formulary** for each medication you take, including the tier it falls in and any prior authorization requirement.
segments.tr: - **Periksa formularium obat** untuk setiap obat yang Anda konsumsi, termasuk tingkatannya (tier) dan persyaratan otorisasi sebelumnya.

segments.src: - **Understand the network type.** HMO plans usually require referrals and in-network care. PPO plans offer more flexibility, often at a higher price.
segments.tr: - **Pahami jenis jaringan.** Rencana HMO biasanya memerlukan rujukan dan perawatan dalam jaringan. Rencana PPO menawarkan lebih banyak fleksibilitas, sering kali dengan harga lebih tinggi.

segments.src: ## A Simple Comparison Checklist
segments.tr: ## Daftar Periksa Perbandingan Sederhana

segments.src: Before you choose, line up your top two or three options and compare:
segments.tr: Sebelum Anda memilih, sejajarkan dua atau tiga opsi teratas Anda dan bandingkan:

segments.src: | Question | Why it matters |
segments.tr: | Pertanyaan | Mengapa ini penting |

segments.src: | Monthly premium after any subsidy | Your fixed monthly cost |
segments.tr: | Premi bulanan setelah subsidi | Biaya bulanan tetap Anda |

segments.src: | Deductible | What you pay before most coverage begins |
segments.tr: | Deduktibel | Apa yang Anda bayar sebelum sebagian besar cakupan dimulai |

segments.src: | Out-of-pocket maximum | Your worst-case yearly spending on covered care |
segments.tr: | Batas maksimum biaya sendiri | Pengeluaran tahunan terburuk Anda untuk perawatan yang dicakup |

segments.src: | Copays and coinsurance | Your cost per visit or service |
segments.tr: | Kofasilitas (copay) dan koinasuransi | Biaya Anda per kunjungan atau layanan |

segments.src: | Network and referrals | Whether your providers are covered |
segments.tr: | Jaringan dan rujukan | Apakah penyedia layanan Anda dicakup |

segments.src: | Drug coverage | Cost of regular prescriptions |
segments.tr: | Cakupan obat | Biaya obat resep rutin |

segments.src: | HSA eligibility (if applicable) | Possible tax-advantaged savings with certain high-deductible plans |
segments.tr: | Kelayakan HSA (jika berlaku) | Kemungkinan tabungan dengan keuntungan pajak dengan rencana deduktibel tinggi tertentu |

segments.src: ## Employer Plans: Extra Items to Review
segments.tr: ## Rencana Pemberi Kerja: Hal Tambahan untuk Ditinjau

segments.src: - **Employer contribution:** Compare how much your employer pays toward each option, since this can change the real cost gap between plans.
segments.tr: - **Kontribusi pemberi kerja:** Bandingkan seberapa besar kontribusi pemberi kerja Anda untuk setiap opsi, karena ini dapat mengubah selisih biaya riil antar rencana.

segments.src: - **Spouse and dependent coverage:** Family costs can rise sharply. Check whether a spouse's employer offers a better option.
segments.tr: - **Cakupan pasangan dan tanggungan:** Biaya keluarga dapat meningkat tajam. Periksa apakah tempat kerja pasangan Anda menawarkan opsi yang lebih baik.

segments.src: - **FSA and HSA rules:** Flexible spending accounts often have use-it-or-lose-it limits. Review deadlines and carryover rules.
segments.tr: - **Aturan FSA dan HSA:** Rekening pengeluaran fleksibel (FSA) sering kali memiliki batas hangus (use-it-or-lose-it). Tinjau tenggat waktu dan aturan sisa saldo yang dapat dibawa ke tahun berikutnya (carryover).

segments.src: - **Opt-out or surcharge rules:** Some employers charge extra if a covered spouse has other coverage available.
segments.tr: - **Aturan penolakan atau biaya tambahan:** Beberapa pemberi kerja mengenakan biaya tambahan jika pasangan yang ditanggung memiliki cakupan lain yang tersedia.

segments.src: ## Avoiding Common Mistakes
segments.tr: ## Menghindari Kesalahan Umum

segments.src: - **Waiting until the last day.** Websites can be slow near deadlines, and a missed date can leave you without coverage.
segments.tr: - **Menunggu hingga hari terakhir.** Situs web bisa menjadi lambat menjelang tenggat waktu, dan tanggal yang terlewat dapat membuat Anda tanpa cakupan.

segments.src: - **Auto-renewing without looking.** Premiums, networks and subsidy amounts may have changed.
segments.tr: - **Memperpanjang otomatis tanpa melihat.** Premi, jaringan, dan jumlah subsidi mungkin telah berubah.

segments.src: - **Choosing on premium alone.** The cheapest plan can be the most expensive if you need significant care.
segments.tr: - **Memilih hanya berdasarkan premi.** Rencana termurah bisa menjadi yang paling mahal jika Anda membutuhkan perawatan yang signifikan.

segments.src: - **Using unofficial sites.** Enroll only through your exchange, your employer's benefits portal or a licensed agent or broker. Be cautious of unsolicited calls or messages asking for personal information.
segments.tr: - **Menggunakan situs tidak resmi.** Mendaftarlah hanya melalui bursa Anda, portal manfaat pemberi kerja Anda, atau agen atau broker berlisensi. Berhati-hatilah terhadap panggilan atau pesan tidak diminta yang meminta informasi pribadi.

segments.src: ## Where to Get Help
segments.tr: ## Tempat Mendapatkan Bantuan

segments.src: Free, trained assistance is available.
segments.tr: Bantuan gratis dan terlatih tersedia.

segments.src: Exchanges offer navigators and certified assistance counselors, and state insurance departments can answer questions about plans and complaints.
segments.tr: Bursa menawarkan navigator dan konselor bantuan bersertifikat, dan departemen asuransi negara bagian dapat menjawab pertanyaan tentang rencana dan keluhan.

segments.src: Your employer's benefits office or human resources team can explain workplace options.
segments.tr: Kantor manfaat atau tim sumber daya manusia pemberi kerja Anda dapat menjelaskan opsi tempat kerja.

segments.src: ## The Bottom Line
segments.tr: ## Intinya

segments.src: Open enrollment rewards a little preparation.
segments.tr: Pendaftaran terbuka memberikan hasil yang baik bagi mereka yang melakukan sedikit persiapan.

segments.src: Gather your income details, list your doctors and prescriptions, note the deadlines that apply to you, and compare total expected costs rather than premiums alone.
segments.tr: Kumpulkan detail pendapatan Anda, buat daftar dokter dan resep Anda, catat tenggat waktu yang berlaku untuk Anda, dan bandingkan total perkiraan biaya daripada premi saja.

segments.src: A review of an hour or two now can help you avoid surprises later.
segments.tr: Tinjauan selama satu atau dua jam sekarang dapat membantu Anda menghindari kejutan di kemudian hari.

segments.src: *This article is for general information only and is not medical, legal, tax or financial advice.
segments.tr: *Artikel ini hanya untuk informasi umum dan bukan merupakan saran medis, hukum, pajak, atau keuangan.

segments.src: Plan details, prices and eligibility rules change, so confirm current information with your exchange, insurer or employer before enrolling.*
segments.tr: Detail rencana, harga, dan aturan kelayakan dapat berubah, jadi konfirmasikan informasi saat ini dengan bursa, perusahaan asuransi, atau pemberi kerja Anda sebelum mendaftar.*

segments.src: For millions of households, the choices made over a few weeks will shape monthly budgets and out-of-pocket costs for the whole next year.

segments.src: ## Two Enrollment Seasons, Two Sets of Rules
segments.tr: ## 2つの加入期間、2つのルール

segments.src: Most people fall into one of two groups.

segments.src: - **Marketplace shoppers** buy individual coverage through HealthCare.gov or a state-run exchange. In most states, the federal window has typically opened on November 1. Some state exchanges run on different schedules, and the end date can differ, so check your own exchange's calendar.
segments.tr: - **マーケットプレイスの利用者**は、HealthCare.govまたは州が運営する取引所を通じて個別の保険に加入します。ほとんどの州では、連邦の窓口は通常11月1日に開始されます。州の取引所によっては異なるスケジュールで運営されており、終了日も異なる場合があるため、自身の取引所のカレンダーを確認してください。

segments.tr: - **職場の保険プランの加入者**は、職場が提供するオプションから選択します。これらの期間は通常、雇用主によって設定され、秋に行われることが多く、期間が短い場合があります。見逃した場合、適格なライフイベントがない限り、来年まで待たなければならない可能性があります。

segments.src: ## Premiums: Look Past the Sticker Price
segments.tr: ## 保険料：見かけの価格に惑わされない

segments.src: Insurers file proposed rates each year, and regulators review them.
segments.tr: 保険会社は毎年、料率案を提出し、規制当局が審査を行います。

segments.src: Whether your own premium goes up, down or stays flat depends on your insurer, county and plan.
segments.tr: 自身の保険料が上がるか、下がるか、あるいは据え置きになるかは、保険会社、郡、プランによって異なります。

segments.src: Drivers commonly cited by insurers include medical costs, prescription drug spending and how many people are enrolled.
segments.tr: 保険会社が一般的に挙げる要因には、医療費、処方薬の支出、加入者数などがあります。

segments.src: When you compare, keep these points in mind:

segments.src: 1. **The monthly premium is only one part of the cost.** A lower premium often comes with a higher deductible.
segments.tr: 1. **月々の保険料はコストの一部にすぎません。** 保険料が低い場合、多くは自己負担免責金額が高くなります。

segments.src: 2. **Check the total picture.** Add up twelve months of premiums, then consider the deductible, copayments, coinsurance and the out-of-pocket maximum.
segments.tr: 2. **全体の状況を確認する。** 12ヶ月分の保険料を合計し、さらに自己負担免責金額、窓口負担（コペイ）、coinsurance（自己負担割合）、および年間自己負担限度額を考慮します。

segments.src: 3. **Compare against your actual use.** If you expect regular specialist visits or ongoing prescriptions, a plan with a higher premium but lower cost-sharing may cost less overall.
segments.tr: 3. **実際の利用状況と比較する。** 専門医の定期的な受診や継続的な処方薬が見込まれる場合、保険料は高くても自己負担割合が低いプランの方が、全体的な費用が安くなる可能性があります。

segments.src: ## Subsidies: Re-Check Your Eligibility
segments.tr: ## 補助金：受給資格を再確認する

segments.src: Marketplace premium tax credits reduce monthly premiums for eligible households.
segments.tr: マーケットプレイスの保険料税額控除は、対象世帯の月々の保険料を軽減します。

segments.src: The amount depends on household income, household size, the cost of benchmark plans in your area and the subsidy rules in effect for the year.
segments.tr: 金額は、世帯収入、世帯規模、お住まいの地域におけるベンチマークプランの費用、およびその年に有効な補助金ルールによって異なります。

segments.src: Because those rules have been subject to change by Congress, do not assume last year's help will look the same this year.
segments.tr: これらのルールは議会によって変更される可能性があるため、昨年の支援が今年も同じであると仮定しないでください。

segments.src: Practical steps:
segments.tr: 実践的なステップ：

segments.src: - **Update your application** with current income and household details instead of letting an old application renew automatically.
segments.tr: - 古い申請を自動更新するのではなく、現在の収入と世帯の詳細情報で**申請内容を更新する**。

segments.src: - **Estimate income carefully.** Credits are generally reconciled when you file taxes, so a large gap between estimated and actual income can lead to owing money or receiving a larger refund.
segments.tr: - **収入を慎重に見積もる。** 控除は通常、納税時に精算されるため、見積もり収入と実際の収入の間に大きなギャップがあると、お金を支払うことになったり、より多くの還付を受けたりすることにつながります。

segments.src: - **Use the exchange's window-shopping or estimator tool** to see your likely cost before you commit.
segments.tr: - **取引所のウィンドウショッピングや見積もりツールを使用して**、申し込む前に予想されるコストを確認する。

segments.src: - **Ask about other help**, such as cost-sharing reductions on certain silver-tier plans for lower-income enrollees, or Medicaid and CHIP, which are available year-round to those who qualify.
segments.tr: - 低所得の加入者向けの特定のシルバー階層プランにおける自己負担軽減措置や、資格を持つ人に通年で利用可能なMedicaidやCHIPなど、**その他の支援について尋ねる**。

segments.src: ## Shrinking Plan Choices: What to Do If Your Plan Changes
segments.tr: ## 縮小するプランの選択肢：プランが変更された場合の対処法

segments.src: In some areas, insurers leave markets, narrow their offerings or adjust their networks.
segments.tr: 地域によっては、保険会社が市場から撤退したり、提供範囲を狭めたり、ネットワークを調整したりすることがあります。

segments.src: Employers may also change carriers or benefit designs.
segments.tr: 雇用主が保険会社や給付内容を変更することもあります。

segments.src: If your current plan is discontinued or altered, you may be moved to a different plan automatically, and it may not match what you had.
segments.tr: 現在のプランが廃止または変更された場合、別のプランに自動的に移行される可能性があり、それは以前のものとは異なる場合があります。

segments.src: - **Read your renewal notice** as soon as it arrives. It should describe changes to cost and coverage.
segments.tr: - **更新通知が届いたらすぐに読む。** 費用や補償内容の変更について記載されているはずです。

segments.src: - **Verify your doctors and hospitals** are in the network of any plan you consider. Use the insurer's directory and, when possible, call the provider's office to confirm.
segments.tr: - **検討しているプランのネットワークに自分の医師や病院が含まれているか確認する。** 保険会社のディレクトリを使用し、可能であれば医療機関のオフィスに電話して確認してください。

segments.src: - **Check the drug formulary** for each medication you take, including the tier it falls in and any prior authorization requirement.
segments.tr: - 服用しているすべての医薬品について、該当する階層や事前承認の要件を含め、**処方薬フォーミュラリを確認する**。

segments.src: - **Understand the network type.** HMO plans usually require referrals and in-network care. PPO plans offer more flexibility, often at a higher price.
segments.tr: - **ネットワークの種類を理解する。** HMOプランは通常、紹介状（リファラル）とネットワーク内の医療を必要とします。PPOプランはより柔軟性を提供しますが、多くの場合、価格が高くなります。

segments.src: ## A Simple Comparison Checklist
segments.tr: ## シンプルな比較チェックリスト

segments.src: Before you choose, line up your top two or three options and compare:
segments.tr: 選択する前に、上位2つまたは3つのオプションを並べて比較します：

segments.src: | Question | Why it matters |
segments.tr: | 質問 | なぜそれが重要か |

segments.src: | Monthly premium after any subsidy | Your fixed monthly cost |
segments.tr: | 補助金適用後の月額保険料 | 固定の月額費用 |

segments.src: | Deductible | What you pay before most coverage begins |
segments.tr: | 自己負担免責金額 (Deductible) | ほとんどの補償が始まる前に支払う金額 |

segments.src: | Out-of-pocket maximum | Your worst-case yearly spending on covered care |
segments.tr: | 年間自己負担限度額 (Out-of-pocket maximum) | 補償対象の医療に対して年間で発生する最悪の場合の支出 |

segments.src: | Copays and coinsurance | Your cost per visit or service |
segments.tr: | 窓口負担 (Copays and coinsurance) | 訪問またはサービスごとの費用 |

segments.src: | Network and referrals | Whether your providers are covered |
segments.tr: | ネットワークと紹介状 | プロバイダーが補償対象かどうか |

segments.src: | Drug coverage | Cost of regular prescriptions |
segments.tr: | 薬の補償 | 定期的な処方薬の費用 |

segments.src: | HSA eligibility (if applicable) | Possible tax-advantaged savings with certain high-deductible plans |
segments.tr: | HSA適格性（該当する場合） | 特定の高額自己負担プランにおける税制優遇された貯蓄の可能性 |

segments.src: ## Employer Plans: Extra Items to Review
segments.tr: ## 職場の保険プラン：確認すべき追加項目

segments.src: - **Employer contribution:** Compare how much your employer pays toward each option, since this can change the real cost gap between plans.
segments.tr: - **雇用主の拠出：** 雇用主が各オプションに対してどれだけ支払っているかを比較します。これにより、プラン間の実際の費用差が変わる可能性があるためです。

segments.src: - **Spouse and dependent coverage:** Family costs can rise sharply. Check whether a spouse's employer offers a better option.
segments.tr: - **配偶者と扶養家族の補償：** 家族の費用は急激に上昇する可能性があります。配偶者の職場がより良いオプションを提供しているかどうかを確認してください。

segments.src: - **FSA and HSA rules:** Flexible spending accounts often have use-it-or-lose-it limits. Review deadlines and carryover rules.
segments.tr: - **FSAとHSAのルール：** フレキシブル支出口座（FSA）には通常、使い切り制限があります。期限と繰越ルールを確認してください。

segments.src: - **Opt-out or surcharge rules:** Some employers charge extra if a covered spouse has other coverage available.
segments.tr: - **オプトアウトまたは追加料金のルール：** 一部の雇用主は、被保険者の配偶者に他の利用可能な補償がある場合、追加料金を請求します。

segments.src: ## Avoiding Common Mistakes
segments.tr: ## よくある間違いを避ける

segments.src: - **Waiting until the last day.** Websites can be slow near deadlines, and a missed date can leave you without coverage.
segments.tr: - **最終日まで待つこと。** 期限の近くではウェブサイトが遅くなる可能性があり、期限を逃すと保険がない状態になる可能性があります。

segments.src: - **Auto-renewing without looking.** Premiums, networks and subsidy amounts may have changed.
segments.tr: - **確認せずに自動更新すること。** 保険料、ネットワーク、補助金の額が変更されている可能性があります。

segments.src: - **Choosing on premium alone.** The cheapest plan can be the most expensive if you need significant care.
segments.tr: - **保険料だけで選ぶこと。** 大きな医療が必要な場合、最も安いプランが最も高価になる可能性があります。

segments.src: - **Using unofficial sites.** Enroll only through your exchange, your employer's benefits portal or a licensed agent or broker. Be cautious of unsolicited calls or messages asking for personal information.
segments.tr: - **非公式のサイトを使用すること。** 取引所、職場の福利厚生ポータル、またはライセンスを持つエージェントやブローカーを通じてのみ加入してください。個人情報を求める不審な電話やメッセージには注意してください。

segments.src: ## Where to Get Help
segments.tr: ## サポートを受ける場所

segments.src: Free, trained assistance is available.
segments.tr: 無料の訓練を受けた支援が利用可能です。

segments.src: Exchanges offer navigators and certified assistance counselors, and state insurance departments can answer questions about plans and complaints.
segments.tr: 取引所はナビゲーターや認定支援カウンセラーを提供しており、州の保険局はプランや苦情に関する質問に答えることができます。

segments.src: Your employer's benefits office or human resources team can explain workplace options.
segments.tr: 職場の福利厚生オフィスや人事チームは、職場のオプションについて説明してくれます。

segments.src: ## The Bottom Line
segments.tr: ## 結論

segments.src: Open enrollment rewards a little preparation.
segments.tr: オープン・エンロールメントは、少しの準備に報いてくれます。

segments.src: Gather your income details, list your doctors and prescriptions, note the deadlines that apply to you, and compare total expected costs rather than premiums alone.
segments.tr: 収入の詳細を集め、医師や処方箋をリストアップし、自分に適用される期限に注意し、保険料だけでなく予想される総費用を比較してください。

segments.src: A review of an hour or two now can help you avoid surprises later.
segments.tr: 今1、2時間見直すことで、後々の予期せぬ事態を避けることができます。

segments.src: *This article is for general information only and is not medical, legal, tax or financial advice.
segments.tr: *この記事は一般的な情報提供のみを目的としており、医療、法的、税務、または財務上のアドバイスではありません。

segments.src: Plan details, prices and eligibility rules change, so confirm current information with your exchange, insurer or employer before enrolling.*
segments.tr: プランの詳細、価格、受給資格のルールは変更されるため、加入前に現在の情報を取引所、保険会社、または雇用主に確認してください。*

de.title: Die offene Einschreibungsphase steht bevor: Was Sie bei Prämien, Subventionen und Tarifwahlen vergleichen sollten

segments.src: Open enrollment is the yearly window when many people can sign up for health coverage or change the plan they already have.
segments.tr: Die offene Einschreibungsphase ist der jährliche Zeitraum, in dem sich viele Menschen für eine Krankenversicherung anmelden oder ihren bestehenden Tarif wechseln können.

segments.src: For millions of households, the choices made over a few weeks will shape monthly budgets and out-of-pocket costs for the whole next year.
segments.tr: Für Millionen von Haushalten bestimmen die Entscheidungen, die innerhalb weniger Wochen getroffen werden, die monatlichen Budgets und die Eigenbeteiligungen für das gesamte nächste Jahr.

segments.src: Details vary by employer, state and insurer, so treat the points below as a general guide and confirm specifics with official sources.
segments.tr: Die Details variieren je nach Arbeitgeber, Bundesland und Versicherer. Betrachten Sie die folgenden Punkte daher als allgemeinen Leitfaden und bestätigen Sie die Einzelheiten bei offiziellen Stellen.

segments.src: ## Two Enrollment Seasons, Two Sets of Rules
segments.tr: ## Zwei Einschreibungsphasen, zwei Regelwerke

segments.src: Most people fall into one of two groups.
segments.tr: Die meisten Menschen fallen in eine von zwei Gruppen.

segments.src: - **Marketplace shoppers** buy individual coverage through HealthCare.gov or a state-run exchange. In most states, the federal window has typically opened on November 1. Some state exchanges run on different schedules, and the end date can differ, so check your own exchange's calendar.
segments.tr: - **Kunden der Börsen (Marketplace shoppers)** schließen eine Individualversicherung über HealthCare.gov oder eine bundesstaatliche Börse ab. In den meisten Bundesstaaten beginnt das Bundesfenster typischerweise am 1. November. Einige staatliche Börsen arbeiten nach anderen Zeitplänen, und das Enddatum kann variieren. Überprüfen Sie daher den Kalender Ihrer eigenen Börse.

segments.src: - **Employer plan members** choose from the options their workplace offers. These windows are usually set by the employer, often in the fall, and can be short. Missing one may mean waiting until next year unless you have a qualifying life event.
segments.tr: - **Mitglieder von Arbeitgebertarifen** wählen aus den Optionen aus, die ihr Arbeitsplatz anbietet. Diese Zeitfenster werden in der Regel vom Arbeitgeber festgelegt, oft im Herbst, und können kurz sein. Das Verpassen eines Fensters kann bedeuten, dass Sie bis zum nächsten Jahr warten müssen, es sei denn, Sie haben ein qualifizierendes Lebensereignis.

segments.src: Qualifying life events, such as losing other coverage, marriage, or the birth of a child, can open a separate special enrollment period.
segments.tr: Qualifizierende Lebensereignisse wie der Verlust einer anderen Absicherung, eine Heirat oder die Geburt eines Kindes können einen separaten Sonderzeitraum für die Einschreibung eröffnen.

segments.src: ## Premiums: Look Past the Sticker Price
segments.tr: ## Prämien: Blicken Sie über den Listenpreis hinaus

segments.src: Insurers file proposed rates each year, and regulators review them.
segments.tr: Versicherer reichen jedes Jahr vorgeschlagene Tarife ein, und die Aufsichtsbehörden überprüfen diese.

segments.src: Whether your own premium goes up, down or stays flat depends on your insurer, county and plan.
segments.tr: Ob Ihre eigene Prämie steigt, sinkt oder gleich bleibt, hängt von Ihrem Versicherer, Ihrem Landkreis und Ihrem Tarif ab.

segments.src: Drivers commonly cited by insurers include medical costs, prescription drug spending and how many people are enrolled.
segments.tr: Von Versicherern häufig genannte Kostentreiber sind medizinische Kosten, Ausgaben für verschreibungspflichtige Medikamente und die Anzahl der Versicherten.

segments.src: When you compare, keep these points in mind:
segments.tr: Behalten Sie beim Vergleichen diese Punkte im Hinterkopf:

segments.src: 1. **The monthly premium is only one part of the cost.** A lower premium often comes with a higher deductible.
segments.tr: 1. **Die monatliche Prämie ist nur ein Teil der Kosten.** Eine niedrigere Prämie geht oft mit einer höheren Selbstbeteiligung einher.

segments.src: 2. **Check the total picture.** Add up twelve months of premiums, then consider the deductible, copayments, coinsurance and the out-of-pocket maximum.
segments.tr: 2. **Überprüfen Sie das Gesamtbild.** Addieren Sie zwölf Monate an Prämien und berücksichtigen Sie dann die Selbstbeteiligung, Zuzahlungen, Mitversicherung und die Obergrenze für die Eigenbeteiligung.

segments.src: 3. **Compare against your actual use.** If you expect regular specialist visits or ongoing prescriptions, a plan with a higher premium but lower cost-sharing may cost less overall.
segments.tr: 3. **Vergleichen Sie mit Ihrer tatsächlichen Nutzung.** Wenn Sie regelmäßige Facharztbesuche oder laufende Verschreibungen erwarten, kann ein Tarif mit einer höheren Prämie, aber geringerer Kostenbeteiligung insgesamt günstiger sein.

segments.src: ## Subsidies: Re-Check Your Eligibility
segments.tr: ## Subventionen: Überprüfen Sie Ihre Anspruchsberechtigung erneut

segments.src: Marketplace premium tax credits reduce monthly premiums for eligible households.
segments.tr: Prämiensteuergutschriften der Börse reduzieren die monatlichen Prämien für berechtigte Haushalte.

segments.src: The amount depends on household income, household size, the cost of benchmark plans in your area and the subsidy rules in effect for the year.
segments.tr: Der Betrag hängt vom Haushaltseinkommen, der Haushaltsgröße, den Kosten für Referenztarife in Ihrer Region und den für das Jahr geltenden Subventionsregeln ab.

segments.src: Because those rules have been subject to change by Congress, do not assume last year's help will look the same this year.
segments.tr: Da diese Regeln vom Kongress geändert werden können, sollten Sie nicht davon ausgehen, dass die Hilfe des letzten Jahres in diesem Jahr genauso aussieht.

segments.src: Practical steps:
segments.tr: Praktische Schritte:

segments.src: - **Update your application** with current income and household details instead of letting an old application renew automatically.
segments.tr: - **Aktualisieren Sie Ihren Antrag** mit den aktuellen Einkommens- und Haushaltsdaten, anstatt einen alten Antrag automatisch verlängern zu lassen.

segments.src: - **Estimate income carefully.** Credits are generally reconciled when you file taxes, so a large gap between estimated and actual income can lead to owing money or receiving a larger refund.
segments.tr: - **Schätzen Sie das Einkommen sorgfältig ein.** Gutschriften werden im Allgemeinen bei der Steuererklärung abgeglichen, sodass eine große Lücke zwischen geschätztem und tatsächlichem Einkommen dazu führen kann, dass Sie Geld schulden oder eine größere Rückerstattung erhalten.

segments.src: - **Use the exchange's window-shopping or estimator tool** to see your likely cost before you commit.
segments.tr: - **Nutzen Sie das Schaufenster- oder Schätztool der Börse**, um Ihre voraussichtlichen Kosten zu sehen, bevor Sie sich festlegen.

segments.src: - **Ask about other help**, such as cost-sharing reductions on certain silver-tier plans for lower-income enrollees, or Medicaid and CHIP, which are available year-round to those who qualify.
segments.tr: - **Fragen Sie nach anderen Hilfen**, wie zum Beispiel Kostenbeteiligungsermäßigungen für bestimmte Tarife der Silber-Kategorie für Versicherte mit geringerem Einkommen oder Medicaid und CHIP, die für qualifizierte Personen das ganze Jahr über verfügbar sind.

segments.src: ## Shrinking Plan Choices: What to Do If Your Plan Changes
segments.tr: ## Schrumpfende Tarifauswahl: Was zu tun ist, wenn sich Ihr Tarif ändert

segments.src: In some areas, insurers leave markets, narrow their offerings or adjust their networks.
segments.tr: In einigen Regionen ziehen sich Versicherer aus Märkten zurück, schränken ihr Angebot ein oder passen ihre Netzwerke an.

segments.src: Employers may also change carriers or benefit designs.
segments.tr: Arbeitgeber können auch die Anbieter oder Leistungsdesigns wechseln.

segments.src: If your current plan is discontinued or altered, you may be moved to a different plan automatically, and it may not match what you had.
segments.tr: Wenn Ihr aktueller Tarif eingestellt oder geändert wird, werden Sie möglicherweise automatisch in einen anderen Tarif eingestuft, und dieser entspricht möglicherweise nicht dem, den Sie hatten.

segments.src: - **Read your renewal notice** as soon as it arrives. It should describe changes to cost and coverage.
segments.tr: - **Lesen Sie Ihre Verlängerungsbenachrichtigung**, sobald sie eintrifft. Sie sollte Änderungen bei Kosten und Versicherungsschutz beschreiben.

segments.src: - **Verify your doctors and hospitals** are in the network of any plan you consider. Use the insurer's directory and, when possible, call the provider's office to confirm.
segments.tr: - **Überprüfen Sie, ob sich Ihre Ärzte und Krankenhäuser** im Netzwerk eines jeden Tarifs befinden, den Sie in Betracht ziehen. Nutzen Sie das Verzeichnis des Versicherers und rufen Sie nach Möglichkeit das Büro des Leistungserbringers an, um dies zu bestätigen.

segments.src: - **Check the drug formulary** for each medication you take, including the tier it falls in and any prior authorization requirement.
segments.tr: - **Überprüfen Sie die Medikamentenliste (Drug Formulary)** für jedes von Ihnen eingenommene Medikament, einschließlich der Stufe, in die es fällt, und aller Anforderungen an eine vorherige Genehmigung.

segments.src: - **Understand the network type.** HMO plans usually require referrals and in-network care. PPO plans offer more flexibility, often at a higher price.
segments.tr: - **Verstehen Sie den Netzwerktyp.** HMO-Tarife erfordern in der Regel Überweisungen und eine Versorgung innerhalb des Netzwerks. PPO-Tarife bieten mehr Flexibilität, oft zu einem höheren Preis.

segments.tr: - **FSA- und HSA-Regeln:** Flexible Spending Accounts haben oft Nutzungslimits („use-it-or-lose-it“). Überprüfen Sie Fristen und Übertragungsregeln.

segments.src: - **Opt-out or surcharge rules:** Some employers charge extra if a covered spouse has other coverage available.
segments.tr: - **Opt-out- oder Aufschlagregeln:** Einige Arbeitgeber erheben zusätzliche Gebühren, wenn ein mitversicherter Ehepartner Zugang zu einer anderen Absicherung hat.

segments.src: ## Avoiding Common Mistakes
segments.tr: ## Vermeidung häufiger Fehler

segments.src: - **Waiting until the last day.** Websites can be slow near deadlines, and a missed date can leave you without coverage.
segments.tr: - **Bis zum letzten Tag warten.** Webseiten können nahe Fristen langsam sein, und ein verpasstes Datum kann dazu führen, dass Sie ohne Versicherungsschutz dastehen.

segments.src: - **Auto-renewing without looking.** Premiums, networks and subsidy amounts may have changed.
segments.tr: - **Automatisch verlängern ohne hinzusehen.** Prämien, Netzwerke und Subventionsbeträge können sich geändert haben.

segments.src: - **Choosing on premium alone.** The cheapest plan can be the most expensive if you need significant care.
segments.tr: - **Nur nach der Prämie auswählen.** Der günstigste Tarif kann der teuerste sein, wenn Sie eine umfangreiche Behandlung benötigen.

segments.src: - **Using unofficial sites.** Enroll only through your exchange, your employer's benefits portal or a licensed agent or broker. Be cautious of unsolicited calls or messages asking for personal information.
segments.tr: - **Nutzung inoffizieller Websites.** Schließen Sie Versicherungen ausschließlich über Ihre Börse, das Leistungsportal Ihres Arbeitgebers oder einen lizenzierten Makler oder Vermittler ab. Seien Sie vorsichtig bei unaufgeforderten Anrufen oder Nachrichten, nach persönlichen Informationen fragen.

segments.src: ## Where to Get Help
segments.tr: ## Wo Sie Hilfe erhalten

segments.src: Free, trained assistance is available.
segments.tr: Kostenlose, geschulte Unterstützung ist verfügbar.

segments.src: Exchanges offer navigators and certified assistance counselors, and state insurance departments can answer questions about plans and complaints.
segments.tr: Börsen bieten Navigatoren und zertifizierte Beratungskräfte an, und staatliche Versicherungsabteilungen können Fragen zu Tarifen und Beschwerden beantworten.

segments.src: Your employer's benefits office or human resources team can explain workplace options.
segments.tr: Die Leistungsabteilung oder das Personalteam Ihres Arbeitgebers kann Ihnen die Optionen am Arbeitsplatz erklären.

segments.src: ## The Bottom Line
segments.tr: ## Fazit

segments.src: Open enrollment rewards a little preparation.
segments.tr: Die offene Einschreibung belohnt ein wenig Vorbereitung.

segments.src: Gather your income details, list your doctors and prescriptions, note the deadlines that apply to you, and compare total expected costs rather than premiums alone.
segments.tr: Tragen Sie Ihre Einkommensdetails zusammen, listen Sie Ihre Ärzte und Rezepte auf, beachten Sie die für Sie geltenden Fristen und vergleichen Sie die erwarteten Gesamtkosten anstelle von reinen Prämien.

segments.src: A review of an hour or two now can help you avoid surprises later.
segments.tr: Eine ein- oder zweistündige Überprüfung jetzt kann Ihnen helfen, spätere Überraschungen zu vermeiden.

segments.tr: *Dieser Artikel dient nur zu allgemeinen Informationszwecken und stellt keine medizinische, rechtliche, steuerliche oder finanzielle Beratung dar.

segments.tr: Tarifdetails, Preise und Berechtigungsregeln ändern sich. Bestätigen Sie daher aktuelle Informationen bei Ihrer Börse, Ihrem Versicherer oder Ihrem Arbeitgeber, bevor Sie sich einschreiben.*

vi.title: Thời Gian Đăng Ký Mở Sắp Đến: Những Gì Cần So Sánh Về Phí Bảo Hiểm, Trợ Cấp và Lựa Chọn Gói

segments.src: Open enrollment is the yearly window when many people can sign up for health coverage or change the plan they already have.
segments.tr: Đăng ký mở là thời điểm hàng năm khi nhiều người có thể đăng ký bảo hiểm y tế hoặc thay đổi gói bảo hiểm hiện có.

segments.src: For millions of households, the choices made over a few weeks will shape monthly budgets and out-of-pocket costs for the whole next year.
segments.tr: Đối với hàng triệu hộ gia đình, những lựa chọn được đưa ra trong vài tuần sẽ định hình ngân sách hàng tháng và chi phí tự trả cho toàn bộ năm tới.

segments.src: Details vary by employer, state and insurer, so treat the points below as a general guide and confirm specifics with official sources.
segments.tr: Chi tiết khác nhau tùy theo chủ sử dụng lao động, tiểu bang và công ty bảo hiểm, vì vậy hãy coi các điểm dưới đây là hướng dẫn chung và xác nhận các chi tiết cụ thể với các nguồn chính thức.

segments.src: ## Two Enrollment Seasons, Two Sets of Rules
segments.tr: ## Hai Mùa Đăng Ký, Hai Bộ Quy Tắc

segments.src: Most people fall into one of two groups.
segments.tr: Hầu hết mọi người thuộc một trong hai nhóm.

segments.src: - **Marketplace shoppers** buy individual coverage through HealthCare.gov or a state-run exchange. In most states, the federal window has typically opened on November 1. Some state exchanges run on different schedules, and the end date can differ, so check your own exchange's calendar.
segments.tr: - **Người mua trên sàn giao dịch** mua bảo hiểm cá nhân thông qua HealthCare.gov hoặc sàn giao dịch do tiểu bang điều hành. Ở hầu hết các tiểu bang, thời gian liên bang thường bắt đầu vào ngày 1 tháng 11. Một số sàn giao dịch tiểu bang hoạt động theo lịch trình khác nhau và ngày kết thúc có thể khác nhau, vì vậy hãy kiểm tra lịch của sàn giao dịch của riêng bạn.

segments.src: - **Employer plan members** choose from the options their workplace offers. These windows are usually set by the employer, often in the fall, and can be short. Missing one may mean waiting until next year unless you have a qualifying life event.
segments.tr: - **Thành viên gói của chủ sử dụng lao động** chọn từ các tùy chọn mà nơi làm việc của họ cung cấp. Những khoảng thời gian này thường do chủ sử dụng lao động ấn định, thường là vào mùa thu và có thể ngắn. Việc bỏ lỡ một thời gian có thể có nghĩa là phải đợi đến năm trừ khi bạn có một sự kiện cuộc sống đủ điều kiện.

segments.src: Qualifying life events, such as losing other coverage, marriage, or the birth of a child, can open a separate special enrollment period.
segments.tr: Các sự kiện cuộc sống đủ điều kiện, chẳng hạn như mất bảo hiểm khác, kết hôn hoặc sinh con, có thể mở ra một thời gian đăng ký đặc biệt riêng.

segments.src: ## Premiums: Look Past the Sticker Price
segments.tr: ## Phí Bảo Hiểm: Nhìn Xa Hơn Giá Niêm Yết

segments.src: Insurers file proposed rates each year, and regulators review them.
segments.tr: Các công ty bảo hiểm nộp mức giá đề xuất mỗi năm và các cơ quan quản lý xem xét chúng.

segments.src: Whether your own premium goes up, down or stays flat depends on your insurer, county and plan.
segments.tr: Việc phí bảo hiểm của riêng bạn tăng, giảm hay giữ nguyên tùy thuộc vào công ty bảo hiểm, quận và gói của bạn.

segments.src: Drivers commonly cited by insurers include medical costs, prescription drug spending and how many people are enrolled.
segments.tr: Các yếu tố thường được các công ty bảo hiểm trích dẫn bao gồm chi phí y tế, chi tiêu cho thuốc theo toa và có bao nhiêu người đăng ký.

segments.src: When you compare, keep these points in mind:
segments.tr: Khi bạn so sánh, hãy ghi nhớ những điểm sau:

segments.src: 1. **The monthly premium is only one part of the cost.** A lower premium often comes with a higher deductible.
segments.tr: 1. **Phí bảo hiểm hàng tháng chỉ là một phần của chi phí.** Phí bảo hiểm thấp hơn thường đi kèm với mức khấu trừ cao hơn.

segments.src: 2. **Check the total picture.** Add up twelve months of premiums, then consider the deductible, copayments, coinsurance and the out-of-pocket maximum.
segments.tr: 2. **Kiểm tra bức tranh tổng thể.** Cộng lại mười hai tháng phí bảo hiểm, sau đó xem xét mức khấu trừ, khoản đồng thanh toán, đồng bảo hiểm và mức tối đa tự trả.

segments.src: 3. **Compare against your actual use.** If you expect regular specialist visits or ongoing prescriptions, a plan with a higher premium but lower cost-sharing may cost less overall.
segments.tr: 3. **So sánh với việc sử dụng thực tế của bạn.** Nếu bạn mong đợi các chuyến khám bác sĩ chuyên khoa thường xuyên hoặc đơn thuốc liên tục, một gói có phí bảo hiểm cao hơn nhưng chia sẻ chi phí thấp hơn có thể tốn ít hơn tổng thể.

segments.src: ## Subsidies: Re-Check Your Eligibility
segments.tr: ## Trợ Cấp: Kiểm Tra Lại Tính Đủ Điều Kiện Của Bạn

segments.src: Marketplace premium tax credits reduce monthly premiums for eligible households.
segments.tr: Các khoản tín dụng thuế phí bảo hiểm sàn giao dịch làm giảm phí bảo hiểm hàng tháng cho các hộ gia đình đủ điều kiện.

segments.src: The amount depends on household income, household size, the cost of benchmark plans in your area and the subsidy rules in effect for the year.
segments.tr: Số tiền phụ thuộc vào thu nhập hộ gia đình, quy mô hộ gia đình, chi phí của các gói chuẩn trong khu vực của bạn và các quy tắc trợ cấp có hiệu lực trong năm.

segments.src: Because those rules have been subject to change by Congress, do not assume last year's help will look the same this year.
segments.tr: Do các quy tắc đó đã bị Quốc hội thay đổi, đừng cho rằng sự trợ giúp của năm ngoái sẽ giống như năm nay.

segments.src: Practical steps:
segments.tr: Các bước thực tế:

segments.src: - **Update your application** with current income and household details instead of letting an old application renew automatically.
segments.tr: - **Cập nhật đơn đăng ký của bạn** với thu nhập hiện tại và chi tiết hộ gia đình thay vì để đơn đăng ký cũ tự động gia hạn.

segments.src: - **Estimate income carefully.** Credits are generally reconciled when you file taxes, so a large gap between estimated and actual income can lead to owing money or receiving a larger refund.
segments.tr: - **Ước tính thu nhập cẩn thận.** Các khoản tín dụng thường được đối chiếu khi bạn nộp thuế, vì vậy khoảng cách lớn giữa thu nhập ước tính và thu nhập thực tế có thể dẫn đến việc nợ tiền hoặc nhận được khoản hoàn lại lớn hơn.

segments.src: - **Use the exchange's window-shopping or estimator tool** to see your likely cost before you commit.
segments.tr: - **Sử dụng công cụ mua sắm hoặc ước tính của sàn giao dịch** để xem chi phí dự kiến của bạn trước khi bạn cam kết.

segments.src: - **Ask about other help**, such as cost-sharing reductions on certain silver-tier plans for lower-income enrollees, or Medicaid and CHIP, which are available year-round to those who qualify.
segments.tr: - **Hỏi về các trợ giúp khác**, chẳng hạn như giảm chia sẻ chi phí đối với một số gói hạng bạc nhất định cho những người đăng ký thu nhập thấp hơn, hoặc Medicaid và CHIP, có sẵn quanh năm cho những người đủ điều kiện.

segments.src: ## Shrinking Plan Choices: What to Do If Your Plan Changes
segments.tr: ## Thu Hẹp Lựa Chọn Gói: Phải Làm Gì Nếu Gói Của Bạn Thay Đổi

segments.src: In some areas, insurers leave markets, narrow their offerings or adjust their networks.
segments.tr: Ở một số khu vực, các công ty bảo hiểm rời khỏi thị trường, thu hẹp các dịch vụ của họ hoặc điều chỉnh mạng lưới của họ.

segments.src: Employers may also change carriers or benefit designs.
segments.tr: Người sử dụng lao động cũng có thể thay đổi nhà cung cấp dịch vụ hoặc thiết kế phúc lợi.

segments.src: If your current plan is discontinued or altered, you may be moved to a different plan automatically, and it may not match what you had.
segments.tr: Nếu gói hiện tại của bạn bị ngừng hoặc thay đổi, bạn có thể được chuyển sang một gói khác tự động và nó có thể không giống với những gì bạn có.

segments.src: - **Read your renewal notice** as soon as it arrives. It should describe changes to cost and coverage.
segments.tr: - **Đọc thông báo gia hạn của bạn** ngay khi nó đến. Nó phải mô tả những thay đổi về chi phí và phạm vi bảo hiểm.

segments.src: - **Verify your doctors and hospitals** are in the network of any plan you consider. Use the insurer's directory and, when possible, call the provider's office to confirm.
segments.tr: - **Xác minh bác sĩ và bệnh viện của bạn** có trong mạng lưới của bất kỳ gói nào bạn xem xét. Sử dụng thư mục của công ty bảo hiểm và khi có thể, hãy gọi đến văn phòng của nhà cung cấp để xác nhận.

segments.src: - **Check the drug formulary** for each medication you take, including the tier it falls in and any prior authorization requirement.
segments.tr: - **Kiểm tra danh mục thuốc** cho mỗi loại thuốc bạn dùng, bao gồm cả cấp bậc mà nó thuộc về và bất kỳ yêu cầu ủy quyền trước nào.

segments.src: - **Understand the network type.** HMO plans usually require referrals and in-network care. PPO plans offer more flexibility, often at a higher price.
segments.tr: - **Hiểu loại mạng lưới.** Các gói HMO thường yêu cầu giới thiệu và chăm sóc trong mạng lưới. Các gói PPO mang lại sự linh hoạt hơn, thường là với giá cao hơn.

segments.src: ## A Simple Comparison Checklist
segments.tr: ## Danh Sách Kiểm Tra So Sánh Đơn Giản

segments.src: Before you choose, line up your top two or three options and compare:
segments.tr: Trước khi bạn chọn, hãy sắp xếp hai hoặc ba tùy chọn hàng đầu của bạn và so sánh:

segments.src: | Question | Why it matters |
segments.tr: | Câu hỏi | Tại sao nó quan trọng |

segments.src: | Monthly premium after any subsidy | Your fixed monthly cost |
segments.tr: | Phí bảo hiểm hàng tháng sau khi trừ trợ cấp | Chi phí hàng tháng cố định của bạn |

segments.src: | Deductible | What you pay before most coverage begins |
segments.tr: | Mức khấu trừ | Những gì bạn trả trước khi hầu hết các phạm vi bảo hiểm bắt đầu |

segments.src: | Out-of-pocket maximum | Your worst-case yearly spending on covered care |
segments.tr: | Tối đa tự trả | Chi tiêu hàng năm tồi tệ nhất của bạn cho dịch vụ chăm sóc được đài thọ |

segments.src: | Copays and coinsurance | Your cost per visit or service |
segments.tr: | Đồng thanh toán và đồng bảo hiểm | Chi phí của bạn cho mỗi lần khám hoặc dịch vụ |

segments.src: | Network and referrals | Whether your providers are covered |
segments.tr: | Mạng lưới và giới thiệu | Liệu các nhà cung cấp của bạn có được đài thọ hay không |

segments.src: | Drug coverage | Cost of regular prescriptions |
segments.tr: | Phạm vi bảo hiểm thuốc | Chi phí của các đơn thuốc thông thường |

segments.src: | HSA eligibility (if applicable) | Possible tax-advantaged savings with certain high-deductible plans |
segments.tr: | Đủ điều kiện HSA (nếu có) | Tiết kiệm có lợi thế về thuế khả thi với một số gói khấu trừ cao nhất định |

segments.src: ## Employer Plans: Extra Items to Review
segments.tr: ## Gói Của Người Sử Dụng Lao Động: Các Mục Bổ Sung Cần Xem Xét

segments.src: - **Employer contribution:** Compare how much your employer pays toward each option, since this can change the real cost gap between plans.
segments.tr: - **Đóng góp của người sử dụng lao động:** So sánh số tiền người sử dụng lao động của bạn chi cho mỗi tùy chọn, vì điều này có thể thay đổi khoảng cách chi phí thực tế giữa các gói.

segments.src: - **Spouse and dependent coverage:** Family costs can rise sharply. Check whether a spouse's employer offers a better option.
segments.tr: - **Phạm vi bảo hiểm cho vợ/chồng và người phụ thuộc:** Chi phí gia đình có thể tăng vọt. Kiểm tra xem người sử dụng lao động của vợ/chồng có cung cấp lựa chọn tốt hơn không.

segments.src: - **FSA and HSA rules:** Flexible spending accounts often have use-it-or-lose-it limits. Review deadlines and carryover rules.
segments.tr: - **Quy tắc FSA và HSA:** Tài khoản chi tiêu linh hoạt thường có giới hạn sử dụng hoặc mất. Xem xét thời hạn và quy tắc chuyển tiếp.

segments.src: - **Opt-out or surcharge rules:** Some employers charge extra if a covered spouse has other coverage available.
segments.tr: - **Quy tắc từ chối hoặc phụ phí:** Một số người sử dụng lao động tính phí phụ thu nếu vợ/chồng được bảo hiểm có sẵn bảo hiểm khác.

segments.src: ## Avoiding Common Mistakes
segments.tr: ## Tránh Các Sai Lầm Phổ Biến

segments.src: - **Waiting until the last day.** Websites can be slow near deadlines, and a missed date can leave you without coverage.
segments.tr: - **Chờ đợi đến ngày cuối cùng.** Các trang web có thể chậm gần thời hạn và ngày bị lỡ có thể khiến bạn không có bảo hiểm.

segments.src: - **Auto-renewing without looking.** Premiums, networks and subsidy amounts may have changed.
segments.tr: - **Tự động gia hạn mà không xem xét.** Phí bảo hiểm, mạng lưới và số tiền trợ cấp có thể đã thay đổi.

segments.src: - **Choosing on premium alone.** The cheapest plan can be the most expensive if you need significant care.
segments.tr: - **Chỉ chọn dựa trên phí bảo hiểm.** Gói rẻ nhất có thể là đắt nhất nếu bạn cần chăm sóc đáng kể.

segments.src: - **Using unofficial sites.** Enroll only through your exchange, your employer's benefits portal or a licensed agent or broker. Be cautious of unsolicited calls or messages asking for personal information.
segments.tr: - **Sử dụng các trang web không chính thức.** Chỉ đăng ký thông qua sàn giao dịch của bạn, cổng thông tin phúc lợi của người sử dụng lao động hoặc đại lý hoặc nhà môi giới được cấp phép. Hãy cẩn thận với các cuộc gọi hoặc tin nhắn không mời mà đến yêu cầu thông tin cá nhân.

segments.src: ## Where to Get Help
segments.tr: ## Nơi Nhận Trợ Giúp

segments.src: Free, trained assistance is available.
segments.tr: Sự hỗ trợ miễn phí, được đào tạo có sẵn.

segments.src: Exchanges offer navigators and certified assistance counselors, and state insurance departments can answer questions about plans and complaints.
segments.tr: Các sàn giao dịch cung cấp hoa tiêu và cố vấn hỗ trợ được chứng nhận, và các bộ phận bảo hiểm tiểu bang có thể trả lời các câu hỏi về gói và khiếu nại.

segments.src: Your employer's benefits office or human resources team can explain workplace options.
segments.tr: Văn phòng phúc lợi hoặc nhóm nhân sự của người sử dụng lao động của bạn có thể giải thích các tùy chọn nơi làm việc.

segments.src: ## The Bottom Line
segments.tr: ## Điểm Mấu Chốt

segments.src: Open enrollment rewards a little preparation.
segments.tr: Đăng ký mở thưởng cho sự chuẩn bị một chút.

segments.src: Gather your income details, list your doctors and prescriptions, note the deadlines that apply to you, and compare total expected costs rather than premiums alone.
segments.tr: Thu thập chi tiết thu nhập của bạn, liệt kê bác sĩ và đơn thuốc của bạn, ghi chú các thời hạn áp dụng cho bạn và so sánh tổng chi phí dự kiến thay vì chỉ phí bảo hiểm.

segments.src: A review of an hour or two now can help you avoid surprises later.
segments.tr: Xem lại một hoặc hai giờ ngay bây giờ có thể giúp bạn tránh những bất ngờ sau này.
